import Heap

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}
variable {leases : LeaseStore}

-- A place identifies one storage occurrence. In particular, equal reference
-- values stored in distinct fields or array elements are counted separately.
def Stored : State Primitive → Place → Slot → Prop
  | .state _ variables _, .variable id, slot => (id, slot) ∈ variables.entries
  | .state objects _ _, .field id name, slot =>
      ∃ fields, (id, Object.aggregate fields) ∈ objects.entries ∧
        (name, slot) ∈ fields.entries
  | .state objects _ _, .element id index, slot =>
      ∃ elements, (id, Object.array elements) ∈ objects.entries ∧
        elements[index]? = some slot

def ReferenceAt (state : State Primitive) (place : Place) (reference : Reference) : Prop :=
  Stored state place (.initialized reference)

-- Object-map membership is separate from liveness through a rooted owning path.
def AllocatedObject : State Primitive → ObjectId → Prop
  | .state objects _ _, id => id ∈ objects.entries.map Prod.fst

def OwnerAt (state : State Primitive) (place : Place) (id : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ReferenceAt state place (.owned id) ∨ ReferenceAt state place (.showned id)

-- These are predicates on arbitrary states, not assumptions built into Step.
-- Lease validity, ownership acyclicity, and reachability from variables are
-- separate obligations: none follows from these ownership conditions alone.
structure OwnershipInvariant (state : State Primitive) : Prop where
  targetsLive : ∀ place id, OwnerAt state place id → AllocatedObject state id
  hasOwner : ∀ id, AllocatedObject state id → ∃ place, OwnerAt state place id
  unique : ∀ place other id,
    ReferenceAt state place (.owned id) → ReferenceAt state other (.owned id) →
      place = other
  exclusive : ∀ place other id,
    ReferenceAt state place (.owned id) → ¬ ReferenceAt state other (.showned id)

theorem Stored.value_unique {state : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot other : Slot}
    (stored : Stored state place slot) (stored' : Stored state place other) :
    slot = other := by
  cases state with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id => exact variables.value_unique stored stored'
    | field id name =>
      obtain ⟨fields, member, field⟩ := stored
      obtain ⟨fields', member', field'⟩ := stored'
      have same := objects.value_unique member member'
      cases same
      exact fields.value_unique field field'
    | element id index =>
      obtain ⟨elements, member, element⟩ := stored
      obtain ⟨elements', member', element'⟩ := stored'
      have same := objects.value_unique member member'
      cases same
      exact Option.some.inj (element.symm.trans element')

theorem Stored.uninitialized_has_no_reference {state : State Primitive} {place : Place}
    (empty : Stored state place .uninitialized) : ∀ reference, ¬ ReferenceAt state place reference := by
  intro reference initialized
  have incompatible := Stored.value_unique empty initialized
  cases incompatible

theorem Stored.element_in_bounds
    {objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive)} {variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot}
    {id : ObjectId} {index : Nat} {slot : Slot}
    (stored : Stored (.state objects variables leases) (.element id index) slot) :
    ∃ elements, (id, Object.array elements) ∈ objects.entries ∧ index < elements.size := by
  obtain ⟨elements, member, element⟩ := stored
  exact ⟨elements, member, (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp element).1⟩

theorem OwnershipInvariant.absent_has_no_owner {state : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant state) (id : ObjectId) (absent : ¬ AllocatedObject state id) :
    ∀ place, ¬ OwnerAt state place id := by
  intro place owner
  exact absent (invariant.targetsLive place id owner)

theorem initial_ownershipInvariant (Primitive : Type) :
    OwnershipInvariant (State.initial Primitive) := by
  have absent : ∀ place reference,
      ¬ ReferenceAt (State.initial Primitive) place reference := by
    intro place reference
    cases place <;> simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty]
  constructor
  · intro place id owner
    rcases owner with owner | owner <;> exact False.elim (absent _ _ owner)
  · intro id live
    simp [AllocatedObject, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty] at live
  · intro place other id owner _
    exact False.elim (absent _ _ owner)
  · intro place other id owner _
    exact absent _ _ owner

-- A reusable preservation lemma for changes to empty storage: ownership depends
-- on stored occurrences and live identities, not on the number of empty slots.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.transport {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (references : ∀ place reference,
      ReferenceAt after place reference ↔ ReferenceAt before place reference)
    (objects : ∀ id, AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  constructor
  · intro place id owner
    apply (objects id).mpr
    apply invariant.targetsLive place id
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mp owner)
    · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mp owner)
  · intro id live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner id ((objects id).mp live)
    refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr owner)
    · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr owner)
  · intro place other id owner owner'
    exact invariant.unique place other id
      ((references _ _).mp owner) ((references _ _).mp owner')
  · intro place other id owner owner'
    exact invariant.exclusive place other id
      ((references _ _).mp owner) ((references _ _).mp owner')

-- Inserting exactly one fresh object and its owner preserves ownership. The
-- no-dangling-owner condition is essential: map freshness alone is insufficient.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.create {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (id : ObjectId) (destination : Place)
    (fresh : ¬ AllocatedObject before id)
    (references : ∀ place reference, ReferenceAt after place reference ↔
      (place = destination ∧ reference = .owned id) ∨ ReferenceAt before place reference)
    (objects : ∀ other, AllocatedObject after other ↔ other = id ∨ AllocatedObject before other) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  have no_owner : ∀ place, ¬ OwnerAt before place id := by
    intro place owner
    exact fresh (invariant.targetsLive place id owner)
  constructor
  · intro place other owner
    apply (objects other).mpr
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
      · exact Or.inl (Reference.owned.inj equal)
      · exact Or.inr (invariant.targetsLive _ _ (Or.inl old))
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
      · cases equal
      · exact Or.inr (invariant.targetsLive _ _ (Or.inr old))
  · intro other live
    rcases (objects other).mp live with rfl | old
    · exact ⟨destination, Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩))⟩
    · obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner other old
      refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
      rcases owner with owner | owner
      · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr owner))
      · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr owner))
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨rfl, equal⟩ | old
    · cases equal
      rcases (references _ _).mp owner' with ⟨equal, _⟩ | old'
      · exact equal.symm
      · exact False.elim (no_owner other (Or.inl old'))
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner' with ⟨rfl, equal⟩ | old'
      · cases equal
        exact False.elim (no_owner place (Or.inl old))
      · exact invariant.unique _ _ _ old old'
  · intro place other target owner shared
    rcases (references _ _).mp shared with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old_shared
    · cases equal
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old_owner
      · cases equal
        exact no_owner other (Or.inr old_shared)
      · exact invariant.exclusive _ _ _ old_owner old_shared

-- Empty aggregate and array slots have no stored reference occurrences.
def ObjectEmpty : Object Primitive → Prop
  | .primitive _ => True
  | .aggregate fields => ∀ name reference,
      (name, Slot.initialized reference) ∉ fields.entries
  | .array elements => ∀ (index : Nat) reference,
      elements[index]? ≠ some (Slot.initialized reference)

theorem initialFields_empty (names : List FieldName) (distinct : names.Nodup) :
    ObjectEmpty (Object.aggregate (Primitive := Primitive) (initialFields names distinct)) := by
  intro name reference member
  have empty := (initialFields_contents names distinct).mp member
  cases empty.2

theorem initialElements_empty (length : Nat) :
    ObjectEmpty (Object.array (Primitive := Primitive) (initialElements length)) := by
  intro index reference
  simp [initialElements, Array.getElem?_replicate]

theorem FiniteMap.initialize_references
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot) (destination : VariableId)
    (empty : (destination, Slot.uninitialized) ∈ variables.entries)
    (reference : Reference) (key : VariableId) (result : Reference) :
    (key, Slot.initialized result) ∈
        (variables.replace destination (.initialized reference)).entries ↔
      (key = destination ∧ result = reference) ∨
        (key, Slot.initialized result) ∈ variables.entries := by
  rw [FiniteMap.replace_contents]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨previous, member, equal⟩
    by_cases same : key = destination
    · simp only [same, ite_true] at equal
      exact Or.inl ⟨same, Slot.initialized.inj equal⟩
    · simp only [same, ite_false] at equal
      exact Or.inr (equal ▸ member)
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | member)
    · exact ⟨.uninitialized, empty, by simp⟩
    · have different : key ≠ destination := by
        intro equal
        subst key
        have incompatible := variables.value_unique member empty
        cases incompatible
      exact ⟨.initialized result, member, by simp [different]⟩

theorem insert_empty_references
    (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive))
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot)
    (id : ObjectId) (object : Object Primitive)
    (fresh : id ∉ objects.entries.map Prod.fst) (objectEmpty : ObjectEmpty object)
    (destination : VariableId)
    (empty : (destination, Slot.uninitialized) ∈ variables.entries)
    (place : Place) (reference : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt
        (.state (objects.insertFresh id object fresh)
          (variables.replace destination (.initialized (.owned id))) leases) place reference ↔
      (place = .variable destination ∧ reference = .owned id) ∨
        ReferenceAt (.state objects variables leases) place reference := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» key =>
    simpa [ReferenceAt, Stored] using
      variables.initialize_references destination empty (.owned id) key reference
  | field target name =>
    simp only [ReferenceAt, Stored, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons,
      reduceCtorEq, false_and, false_or]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨fields, (equal | member), field⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, equal⟩ := Prod.mk.inj equal
        subst object
        exact False.elim (objectEmpty name reference field)
      · exact ⟨fields, member, field⟩
    · rintro ⟨fields, member, field⟩
      exact ⟨fields, Or.inr member, field⟩
  | element target index =>
    simp only [ReferenceAt, Stored, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons,
      reduceCtorEq, false_and, false_or]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨elements, (equal | member), element⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, equal⟩ := Prod.mk.inj equal
        subst object
        exact False.elim (objectEmpty index reference element)
      · exact ⟨elements, member, element⟩
    · rintro ⟨elements, member, element⟩
      exact ⟨elements, Or.inr member, element⟩

theorem insert_empty_preserves_ownership
    (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive))
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot)
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant (.state objects variables leases))
    (id : ObjectId) (object : Object Primitive)
    (fresh : id ∉ objects.entries.map Prod.fst) (objectEmpty : ObjectEmpty object)
    (destination : VariableId)
    (empty : (destination, Slot.uninitialized) ∈ variables.entries) :
    OwnershipInvariant
      (.state (objects.insertFresh id object fresh)
        (variables.replace destination (.initialized (.owned id))) leases) := by
  apply invariant.create id (.variable destination) fresh
  · exact insert_empty_references objects variables id object fresh objectEmpty destination empty
  · intro target
    simp [AllocatedObject, FiniteMap.insertFresh]

theorem step_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {operation : Operation Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (step : Step Primitive before operation after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  cases step with
  | allocVariable objects variables id fresh =>
    apply invariant.transport
    · intro place reference
      cases place <;> simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, FiniteMap.insertFresh]
    · intro target
      rfl
  | deallocVariable objects variables id empty _ =>
    apply invariant.transport
    · intro place reference
      cases place with
      | «variable» key =>
        simp only [ReferenceAt, Stored, FiniteMap.erase, List.mem_filter,
          decide_eq_true_eq]
        constructor
        · exact And.left
        · intro member
          refine ⟨member, ?_⟩
          intro equal
          subst key
          have incompatible := variables.value_unique member empty
          cases incompatible
      | field target name => rfl
      | element target index => rfl
    · intro target
      rfl
  | createPrimitive objects variables value destination empty id fresh =>
    exact insert_empty_preserves_ownership objects variables invariant id
      (.primitive value) fresh True.intro destination empty
  | createAggregate objects variables fields distinct destination empty id fresh =>
    exact insert_empty_preserves_ownership objects variables invariant id
      (.aggregate (initialFields fields distinct)) fresh
      (initialFields_empty fields distinct) destination empty
  | createArray objects variables length destination empty id fresh =>
    exact insert_empty_preserves_ownership objects variables invariant id
      (.array (initialElements length)) fresh (initialElements_empty length) destination empty

-- Reachable deliberately names the current allocation/creation Step relation.
-- Adding place operations requires a corresponding preservation proof, rather
-- than silently treating their post-state invariant as a transition premise.
inductive Reachable (Primitive : Type) : State Primitive → Prop where
  | initial : Reachable Primitive (State.initial Primitive)
  | step {before after : State Primitive} {operation : Operation Primitive}
      (reachable : Reachable Primitive before)
      (transition : Step Primitive before operation after) : Reachable Primitive after

theorem reachable_ownershipInvariant {state : State Primitive}
    (reachable : Reachable Primitive state) : OwnershipInvariant state := by
  induction reachable with
  | initial => exact initial_ownershipInvariant Primitive
  | step _ transition invariant => exact step_preserves_ownership invariant transition

-- Moving a reference relocates one occurrence without changing ownership kind.
-- The effect equation is supplied by a concrete place-update proof; it is not a
-- post-state invariant premise and applies to every reference, including leases.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.move {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (source destination : Place)
    (reference : Reference) (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
    (references : ∀ place result, ReferenceAt after place result ↔
      (place = destination ∧ result = reference) ∨
        (place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place result))
    (objects : ∀ id, AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  constructor
  · intro place id owner
    apply (objects id).mpr
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
      · exact invariant.targetsLive source id (Or.inl (equal ▸ stored))
      · exact invariant.targetsLive place id (Or.inl old)
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
      · exact invariant.targetsLive source id (Or.inr (equal ▸ stored))
      · exact invariant.targetsLive place id (Or.inr old)
  · intro id live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner id ((objects id).mp live)
    by_cases same : place = source
    · subst place
      refine ⟨destination, ?_⟩
      rcases owner with owner | owner
      · have equal : .owned id = reference :=
          Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner stored)
        exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, equal⟩))
      · have equal : .showned id = reference :=
          Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner stored)
        exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, equal⟩))
    · refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
      rcases owner with owner | owner
      · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨same, owner⟩))
      · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨same, owner⟩))
  · intro place other id owner owner'
    rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨rfl, equal⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner' with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨different', old'⟩
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (different'
          (invariant.unique source other id (equal ▸ stored) old').symm)
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner' with ⟨rfl, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old'⟩
      · exact False.elim (different
          (invariant.unique place source id old (equal ▸ stored)))
      · exact invariant.unique place other id old old'
  · intro place other id owner shared
    rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
    · rcases (references _ _).mp shared with ⟨_, equal'⟩ | ⟨_, old'⟩
      · cases equal.trans equal'.symm
      · exact invariant.exclusive source other id (equal ▸ stored) old'
    · rcases (references _ _).mp shared with ⟨_, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old'⟩
      · exact invariant.exclusive place source id old (equal ▸ stored)
      · exact invariant.exclusive place other id old old'

theorem OwnershipInvariant.transportOwners {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (owned : ∀ place id,
      ReferenceAt after place (.owned id) ↔ ReferenceAt before place (.owned id))
    (showned : ∀ place id,
      ReferenceAt after place (.showned id) ↔ ReferenceAt before place (.showned id))
    (objects : ∀ id, AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  constructor
  · intro place id owner
    apply (objects id).mpr
    apply invariant.targetsLive place id
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((owned _ _).mp owner)
    · exact Or.inr ((showned _ _).mp owner)
  · intro id live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner id ((objects id).mp live)
    refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((owned _ _).mpr owner)
    · exact Or.inr ((showned _ _).mpr owner)
  · intro place other id owner owner'
    exact invariant.unique place other id ((owned _ _).mp owner) ((owned _ _).mp owner')
  · intro place other id owner owner'
    exact invariant.exclusive place other id ((owned _ _).mp owner) ((showned _ _).mp owner')

theorem OwnershipInvariant.duplicateShared {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (source destination : Place)
    (id : ObjectId) (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
    (references : ∀ place reference, ReferenceAt after place reference ↔
      (place = destination ∧ reference = .showned id) ∨ ReferenceAt before place reference)
    (objects : ∀ other, AllocatedObject after other ↔ AllocatedObject before other) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  constructor
  · intro place other owner
    apply (objects other).mpr
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
      · cases equal
      · exact invariant.targetsLive place other (Or.inl old)
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
      · cases equal
        exact invariant.targetsLive source id (Or.inr stored)
      · exact invariant.targetsLive place other (Or.inr old)
  · intro other live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner other ((objects other).mp live)
    refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr owner))
    · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr (Or.inr owner))
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
    · cases equal
    · rcases (references _ _).mp owner' with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old'
      · cases equal
      · exact invariant.unique place other target old old'
  · intro place other target owner shared
    rcases (references _ _).mp owner with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old
    · cases equal
    · rcases (references _ _).mp shared with ⟨_, equal⟩ | old'
      · cases equal
        exact invariant.exclusive place source id old stored
      · exact invariant.exclusive place other target old old'

theorem OwnerAt.target_unique {state : State Primitive} {place : Place} {id other : ObjectId}
    (owner : OwnerAt state place id) (owner' : OwnerAt state place other) : id = other := by
  rcases owner with owner | owner <;> rcases owner' with owner' | owner'
  · exact Reference.owned.inj (Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner owner'))
  · have incompatible := Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner owner')
    cases incompatible
  · have incompatible := Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner owner')
    cases incompatible
  · exact congrArg Reference.object (Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique owner owner'))

-- Dropping a final owner of an object with no reference-bearing contents removes
-- exactly that occurrence and object. Recursive destruction needs its own effect
-- proof before it can use a more general invariant-preservation theorem.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.dropLeaf {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (source : Place) (id : ObjectId)
    (stored : OwnerAt before source id)
    (lastOwner : ∀ place, OwnerAt before place id → place = source)
    (references : ∀ place reference, ReferenceAt after place reference ↔
      place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place reference)
    (objects : ∀ other, AllocatedObject after other ↔ AllocatedObject before other ∧ other ≠ id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  have old_owner : ∀ place target, OwnerAt after place target →
      place ≠ source ∧ OwnerAt before place target := by
    intro place target owner
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · obtain ⟨different, owner⟩ := (references _ _).mp owner
      exact ⟨different, Or.inl owner⟩
    · obtain ⟨different, owner⟩ := (references _ _).mp owner
      exact ⟨different, Or.inr owner⟩
  constructor
  · intro place target owner
    obtain ⟨different, owner⟩ := old_owner place target owner
    apply (objects target).mpr
    refine ⟨invariant.targetsLive place target owner, ?_⟩
    intro equal
    subst target
    exact different (lastOwner place owner)
  · intro target live
    obtain ⟨live, different⟩ := (objects target).mp live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner target live
    have different_place : place ≠ source := by
      intro equal
      subst place
      exact different (owner.target_unique stored)
    refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr ⟨different_place, owner⟩)
    · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr ⟨different_place, owner⟩)
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    exact invariant.unique place other target
      ((references _ _).mp owner).2 ((references _ _).mp owner').2
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    exact invariant.exclusive place other target
      ((references _ _).mp owner).2 ((references _ _).mp owner').2

theorem OwnershipInvariant.releaseShared {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (source other : Place) (id : ObjectId)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
    (remaining : ReferenceAt before other (.showned id)) (different : other ≠ source)
    (references : ∀ place reference, ReferenceAt after place reference ↔
      place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place reference)
    (objects : ∀ target, AllocatedObject after target ↔ AllocatedObject before target) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  constructor
  · intro place target owner
    apply (objects target).mpr
    apply invariant.targetsLive place target
    rcases owner with owner | owner
    · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mp owner).2
    · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mp owner).2
  · intro target live
    obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner target ((objects target).mp live)
    by_cases same : place = source
    · subst place
      have equal : target = id := owner.target_unique (Or.inr stored)
      subst target
      exact ⟨other, Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr ⟨different, remaining⟩)⟩
    · refine ⟨place, ?_⟩
      rcases owner with owner | owner
      · exact Or.inl ((references _ _).mpr ⟨same, owner⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ((references _ _).mpr ⟨same, owner⟩)
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    exact invariant.unique place other target
      ((references _ _).mp owner).2 ((references _ _).mp owner').2
  · intro place other target owner owner'
    exact invariant.exclusive place other target
      ((references _ _).mp owner).2 ((references _ _).mp owner').2

-- The pointwise invariant entails the paper's disjunction: exactly one owned
-- occurrence and no showned occurrence, or at least one showned occurrence and
-- no owned occurrence. Places distinguish occurrences even when values match.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.ownership_cases {state : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant state) (id : ObjectId) (live : AllocatedObject state id) :
    (∃ place, ReferenceAt state place (.owned id) ∧
      (∀ other, ReferenceAt state other (.owned id) → other = place) ∧
      (∀ other, ¬ ReferenceAt state other (.showned id))) ∨
    (∃ place, ReferenceAt state place (.showned id) ∧
      (∀ other, ¬ ReferenceAt state other (.owned id))) := by
  obtain ⟨place, owner⟩ := invariant.hasOwner id live
  rcases owner with owner | owner
  · exact Or.inl ⟨place, owner,
      fun other owner' => invariant.unique other place id owner' owner,
      fun other => invariant.exclusive place other id owner⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨place, owner,
      fun other owner' => invariant.exclusive other place id owner' owner⟩

theorem OwnershipInvariant.addBorrow {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (destination : Place) (reference : Reference)
    (nonowning : ∀ id, reference ≠ .owned id ∧ reference ≠ .showned id)
    (references : ∀ place result, ReferenceAt after place result ↔
      (place = destination ∧ result = reference) ∨ ReferenceAt before place result)
    (objects : ∀ id, AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  apply invariant.transportOwners (objects := objects)
  · intro place id
    rw [references]
    have unequal := (nonowning id).1
    simp only [Ne.symm unequal, and_false, false_or]
  · intro place id
    rw [references]
    have unequal := (nonowning id).2
    simp only [Ne.symm unequal, and_false, false_or]

theorem OwnershipInvariant.removeBorrow {before after : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (source : Place) (reference : Reference)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
    (nonowning : ∀ id, reference ≠ .owned id ∧ reference ≠ .showned id)
    (references : ∀ place result, ReferenceAt after place result ↔
      place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place result)
    (objects : ∀ id, AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  apply invariant.transportOwners (objects := objects)
  · intro place id
    rw [references]
    constructor
    · exact And.right
    · intro owner
      refine ⟨?_, owner⟩
      intro equal
      subst place
      exact (nonowning id).1 (Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique stored owner))
  · intro place id
    rw [references]
    constructor
    · exact And.right
    · intro owner
      refine ⟨?_, owner⟩
      intro equal
      subst place
      exact (nonowning id).2 (Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique stored owner))

-- Two independent roots authorize one combined lease, followed by a reborrow.
def leaseDiamond : LeaseStore :=
  .store
    { entries := [
        (⟨0⟩, .entry (.root ⟨10⟩) true),
        (⟨1⟩, .entry (.root ⟨20⟩) true),
        (⟨2⟩, .entry (.sublease [⟨0⟩, ⟨1⟩]) true),
        (⟨3⟩, .entry (.sublease [⟨2⟩]) true)]
      uniqueKeys := by decide }
    4

theorem leaseDiamond_wellFormed : leaseDiamond.WellFormed := by
  constructor
  · intro id entry stored
    simp [leaseDiamond] at stored
    rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> decide
  · intro id entry stored parent member
    simp [leaseDiamond] at stored
    rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    all_goals simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
    · rcases member with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨.entry (.root ⟨10⟩) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], by decide⟩
      · exact ⟨.entry (.root ⟨20⟩) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], by decide⟩
    · subst parent
      exact ⟨.entry (.sublease [⟨0⟩, ⟨1⟩]) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], by decide⟩
  · intro id entry parents stored kind
    simp [leaseDiamond] at stored
    rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    all_goals simp only at kind
    all_goals cases kind
    all_goals decide
  · intro id entry stored valid parent member
    simp [leaseDiamond] at stored
    rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    all_goals simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
    · rcases member with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨.entry (.root ⟨10⟩) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨.entry (.root ⟨20⟩) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], rfl⟩
    · subst parent
      exact ⟨.entry (.sublease [⟨0⟩, ⟨1⟩]) true, by simp [leaseDiamond], rfl⟩

theorem leaseDiamond_combined_first : LeaseAncestor leaseDiamond ⟨2⟩ ⟨0⟩ :=
  .parent (.parent (entry := .entry (.sublease [⟨0⟩, ⟨1⟩]) true)
    (by simp [leaseDiamond]) (by simp [LeaseNode.parents]))

theorem leaseDiamond_combined_second : LeaseAncestor leaseDiamond ⟨2⟩ ⟨1⟩ :=

theorem leaseDiamond_reborrow : LeaseAncestor leaseDiamond ⟨3⟩ ⟨2⟩ :=
  .parent (.parent (entry := .entry (.sublease [⟨2⟩]) true)

theorem invalidLeaseChain_wellFormed : invalidLeaseChain.WellFormed := by
  constructor
  · intro id entry stored

  · intro id entry stored parent member
    simp [invalidLeaseChain] at stored
    rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
    · simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
      subst parent

  · intro id entry parents stored kind

    all_goals cases kind
    decide

theorem empty_state_has_no_stored_lease (store : LeaseStore) (id : LeaseId) :
    ¬ StoredLease (State.state (Primitive := Nat) FiniteMap.empty FiniteMap.empty store) id := by
  intro stored
  cases stored with
  | variableSlot present => simp [FiniteMap.empty] at present
  | field present => simp [FiniteMap.empty] at present
  | element present => simp [FiniteMap.empty] at present

theorem invalid_child_collects : CleanupLease unreferencedInvalidLeases afterChildCleanup := by
  apply CleanupLease.remove (entry := .entry (.sublease [⟨0⟩]) false)
  · simp [unreferencedInvalidLeases, invalidLeaseChain]
  · rintro (stored | ⟨child, edge⟩)
    · exact empty_state_has_no_stored_lease _ _ stored
    · cases edge with
      | parent stored member =>
        simp [unreferencedInvalidLeases, invalidLeaseChain] at stored
        rcases stored with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        all_goals simp [LeaseNode.parents, LeaseId.mk.injEq] at member

theorem invalid_parent_collects : CleanupLease afterChildCleanup afterAllCleanup := by
  have step := CleanupLease.remove afterChildCleanup ⟨0⟩ (.entry (.root ⟨10⟩) false)
    (by simp [afterChildCleanup, invalidLeaseChain, FiniteMap.erase])
    (by
      rintro (stored | ⟨child, edge⟩)
      · exact empty_state_has_no_stored_lease _ _ stored
      · cases edge with
        | parent stored member =>
          simp [afterChildCleanup, invalidLeaseChain, FiniteMap.erase] at stored
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := stored
          simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member)
  exact step

-- ANCHOR: lease_dag_invalid_retention_cleanup
example :
    LeaseRetained retainedInvalidLease ⟨1⟩ ∧
    LeaseRetained retainedInvalidLease ⟨0⟩ ∧
    InvalidLeaseUse retainedInvalidLease.leases (.reference .shared (some ⟨1⟩) ⟨10⟩) ∧
    FullLeaseCleanup unreferencedInvalidLeases afterAllCleanup ∧
    afterAllCleanup.leases.freshId = ⟨2⟩ ∧
    (⟨0⟩ : LeaseId) ≠ afterAllCleanup.leases.freshId ∧
    (⟨1⟩ : LeaseId) ≠ afterAllCleanup.leases.freshId := by
  refine ⟨Or.inl retainedInvalidLease_child,
    Or.inr ⟨⟨1⟩, retainedInvalidLease_parent⟩, ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨1⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨entry, stored, valid⟩
    simp [retainedInvalidLease, invalidLeaseChain] at stored
    subst entry
    cases valid
  · exact ⟨.next invalid_child_collects (.next invalid_parent_collects (.done _)),
      by intro id entry stored; simp [afterAllCleanup, FiniteMap.empty] at stored⟩
  · decide
  · decide
-- ANCHOR_END: lease_dag_invalid_retention_cleanup

-- A new root takes the next identity even after all earlier nodes are gone.
-- ANCHOR: lease_dag_fresh_allocation
example :
    ∃ next, AllocateLease afterAllCleanup.leases (.root ⟨30⟩) ⟨2⟩ next ∧
      next.nextId = 3 ∧ LeaseUsable next ⟨2⟩ := by
  have wf : afterAllCleanup.leases.WellFormed := by
    constructor
    · intro id entry stored
      simp [afterAllCleanup, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
    · intro id entry stored
      simp [afterAllCleanup, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
    · intro id entry parents stored
      simp [afterAllCleanup, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
    · intro id entry stored
      simp [afterAllCleanup, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
  refine ⟨afterAllCleanup.leases.allocate wf (.root ⟨30⟩),
    .allocate _ wf _ trivial, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨.entry (.root ⟨30⟩) true, by simp [LeaseStore.allocate, FiniteMap.insertFresh,
    afterAllCleanup, LeaseStore.freshId], rfl⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: lease_dag_fresh_allocation

end Dada.Heap

import Heap

namespace Dada.Heap

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

-- Parent identities, unlike object targets, describe borrowing history.
def LeaseNode.parents : LeaseNode → List LeaseId
  | .root _ => []
  | .sublease parents => parents

def LeaseStore.lookup (store : LeaseStore) (id : LeaseId) : Option LeaseEntry :=
  (store.nodes.entries.find? fun pair => pair.1 == id).map Prod.snd

-- Edges point from a newer lease to the leases which authorize it.
inductive LeaseParent (store : LeaseStore) : LeaseId → LeaseId → Prop where
  | parent {child parent : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry}
      (stored : (child, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries)
      (member : parent ∈ entry.node.parents) : LeaseParent store child parent

-- Strict ancestry: a node is not its own ancestor in a well-formed DAG.
inductive LeaseAncestor (store : LeaseStore) : LeaseId → LeaseId → Prop where
  | parent {child parent : LeaseId} :
      LeaseParent store child parent → LeaseAncestor store child parent
  | trans {child middle parent : LeaseId} :
      LeaseAncestor store child middle → LeaseAncestor store middle parent →
      LeaseAncestor store child parent

structure LeaseStore.WellFormed (store : LeaseStore) : Prop where
  bounded : ∀ id entry, (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries → id.index < store.nextId
  parents : ∀ id entry, (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries →
    ∀ parent ∈ entry.node.parents,
      ∃ parentEntry, (parent, parentEntry) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧ parent.index < id.index
  subleases : ∀ id entry parents, (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries →
    entry.node = .sublease parents → parents ≠ [] ∧ parents.Nodup
  validity : ∀ id entry, (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries → entry.valid = true →
    ∀ parent ∈ entry.node.parents,
      ∃ parentEntry, (parent, parentEntry) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧ parentEntry.valid = true

theorem LeaseStore.empty_wellFormed : LeaseStore.empty.WellFormed := by
  constructor
  · intro id entry stored
    simp [LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
  · intro id entry stored
    simp [LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
  · intro id entry parents stored
    simp [LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
  · intro id entry stored
    simp [LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty] at stored

theorem LeaseAncestor.decreases {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    {child parent : LeaseId} (ancestor : LeaseAncestor store child parent) :
    parent.index < child.index := by
  induction ancestor with
  | parent edge =>
    cases edge with
    | parent stored member => exact (wf.parents _ _ stored _ member).choose_spec.2
  | trans _ _ first second => exact Nat.lt_trans second first

theorem LeaseAncestor.irreflexive {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    (id : LeaseId) : ¬ LeaseAncestor store id id := by
  intro ancestor
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (ancestor.decreases wf)

-- Allocation takes the monotonic counter, never a previously collected identity.
def LeaseStore.freshId (store : LeaseStore) : LeaseId := ⟨store.nextId⟩

theorem LeaseStore.freshId_absent {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed) :
    store.freshId ∉ store.nodes.entries.map Prod.fst := by
  intro member
  obtain ⟨⟨id, entry⟩, stored, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  simp only at equal
  subst id
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (wf.bounded _ _ stored)

-- A root has no parents. A sublease needs at least one distinct, valid parent.
def LeaseNode.Admissible (store : LeaseStore) : LeaseNode → Prop
  | .root _ => True
  | .sublease parents => parents ≠ [] ∧ parents.Nodup ∧
      ∀ parent ∈ parents, ∃ entry,
        (parent, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧ entry.valid = true

def LeaseStore.allocate (store : LeaseStore) (wf : store.WellFormed)
    (node : LeaseNode) : LeaseStore :=
  .store (store.nodes.insertFresh store.freshId (.entry node true) (LeaseStore.freshId_absent wf))
    (store.nextId + 1)

-- The state-level borrow operation also checks that the root object exists and
-- supplies the target/access mode. This relation is only lease-node allocation.
inductive AllocateLease : LeaseStore → LeaseNode → LeaseId → LeaseStore → Prop where
  | allocate (store : LeaseStore) (wf : store.WellFormed) (node : LeaseNode)
      (admissible : node.Admissible store) :
      AllocateLease store node store.freshId (store.allocate wf node)

theorem LeaseStore.allocate_wellFormed {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    {node : LeaseNode} (admissible : node.Admissible store) :
    (store.allocate wf node).WellFormed := by
  constructor
  · intro id entry stored
    simp only [allocate, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      simp [allocate, freshId]
    · exact Nat.lt_trans (wf.bounded _ _ stored) (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  · intro id entry stored parent member
    simp only [allocate, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      cases node with
      | root object => simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
      | sublease parents =>
        obtain ⟨parentEntry, found, _⟩ := admissible.2.2 parent member
        exact ⟨parentEntry, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ found, wf.bounded _ _ found⟩
    · obtain ⟨parentEntry, found, older⟩ := wf.parents _ _ stored _ member
      exact ⟨parentEntry, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ found, older⟩
  · intro id entry parents stored kind
    simp only [allocate, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      change node = .sublease parents at kind
      subst node
      exact ⟨admissible.1, admissible.2.1⟩
    · exact wf.subleases _ _ _ stored kind
  · intro id entry stored valid parent member
    simp only [allocate, FiniteMap.insertFresh, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      cases node with
      | root object => simp [LeaseNode.parents] at member
      | sublease parents =>
        obtain ⟨parentEntry, found, valid⟩ := admissible.2.2 parent member
        exact ⟨parentEntry, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ found, valid⟩
    · obtain ⟨parentEntry, found, valid⟩ := wf.validity _ _ stored valid _ member
      exact ⟨parentEntry, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ found, valid⟩

-- An owner write revokes all roots for that object and their descendants.
def OwnerInvalidates (store : LeaseStore) (object : ObjectId) (id : LeaseId) : Prop :=
  ∃ root entry, (root, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧ entry.node = .root object ∧
    (id = root ∨ LeaseAncestor store id root)

-- A lease write revokes strict descendants, not the lease used for the write.
def LeaseInvalidates (store : LeaseStore) (authority id : LeaseId) : Prop :=
  LeaseAncestor store id authority

-- Invalidation changes validity only. The relation is semantic, not a mandated
-- executable graph algorithm; no reference or node is removed here.
noncomputable def LeaseStore.invalidate (store : LeaseStore)
    (revoked : LeaseId → Prop) : LeaseStore := by
  classical
  exact .store
    { entries := store.nodes.entries.map fun pair =>
        (pair.1, .entry pair.2.node (if revoked pair.1 then false else pair.2.valid))
      uniqueKeys := by
        simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using store.nodes.uniqueKeys }
    store.nextId

noncomputable def invalidateOwner (store : LeaseStore) (object : ObjectId) : LeaseStore :=
  store.invalidate (OwnerInvalidates store object)

noncomputable def invalidateLease (store : LeaseStore) (authority : LeaseId) : LeaseStore :=
  store.invalidate (LeaseInvalidates store authority)

-- Stored invalid leases are permitted. Only attempting to use one is UB.
def LeaseUsable (store : LeaseStore) (id : LeaseId) : Prop :=
  ∃ entry, (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧ entry.valid = true

def InvalidLeaseUse (store : LeaseStore) (reference : Reference) : Prop :=
  ∃ id, reference.lease = some id ∧ ¬ LeaseUsable store id

-- Unique access is a prerequisite for mutation; shared references cannot write.
inductive LeaseWrite : LeaseStore → Reference → LeaseStore → Prop where
  | owner (store : LeaseStore) (object : ObjectId) :
      LeaseWrite store (.reference .unique none object) (invalidateOwner store object)
  | borrowed (store : LeaseStore) (id : LeaseId) (object : ObjectId)
      (usable : LeaseUsable store id) :
      LeaseWrite store (.reference .unique (some id) object) (invalidateLease store id)

-- Lease identities directly mentioned by initialized slots anywhere in state.
inductive StoredLease (state : State Primitive) : LeaseId → Prop where
  | variableSlot {variableId : VariableId} {reference : Reference} {id : LeaseId}
      (stored : (variableId, .initialized reference) ∈ state.variables.entries)
      (lease : reference.lease = some id) : StoredLease state id
  | field {object : ObjectId} {fields : FiniteMap FieldName Slot}
      {name : FieldName} {reference : Reference} {id : LeaseId}
      (allocated : (object, .aggregate fields) ∈ state.objects.entries)
      (stored : (name, .initialized reference) ∈ fields.entries)
      (lease : reference.lease = some id) : StoredLease state id
  | element {object : ObjectId} {elements : Array Slot}
      {reference : Reference} {id : LeaseId}
      (allocated : (object, .array elements) ∈ state.objects.entries)
      (stored : .initialized reference ∈ elements.toList)
      (lease : reference.lease = some id) : StoredLease state id

-- Both valid and invalid references retain their nodes. A parent is retained by
-- any remaining child even when no slot mentions that parent directly.
def LeaseRetained (state : State Primitive) (id : LeaseId) : Prop :=
  StoredLease state id ∨ ∃ child, LeaseParent state.leases child id

-- Cleanup removes one unreferenced leaf. Repetition also collects parents whose
-- last child was removed. The allocation counter is deliberately unchanged.
inductive CleanupLease : State Primitive → State Primitive → Prop where
  | remove (state : State Primitive) (id : LeaseId) (entry : LeaseEntry)
      (found : (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries)
      (unused : ¬ LeaseRetained state id) :
      CleanupLease state
        (.state state.objects state.variables
          (.store (state.leases.nodes.erase id) state.leases.nextId))

inductive CleanupLeases : State Primitive → State Primitive → Prop where
  | done (state : State Primitive) : CleanupLeases state state
  | next {before middle after : State Primitive} :
      CleanupLease before middle → CleanupLeases middle after → CleanupLeases before after

-- Every surviving entry has exactly its former node and possibly revoked validity.
theorem LeaseStore.invalidate_entry {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} :
    (id, entry) ∈ (store.invalidate revoked).nodes.entries ↔
      ∃ old, (id, old) ∈ store.nodes.entries ∧
        entry = .entry old.node (if revoked id then false else old.valid) := by
  classical
  simp only [invalidate, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨key, old⟩, stored, equal⟩
    have keyEq := congrArg Prod.fst equal
    simp only at keyEq
    subst key
    exact ⟨old, stored, (congrArg Prod.snd equal).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨old, stored, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(id, old), stored, rfl⟩

theorem LeaseStore.invalidate_stored {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} (stored : (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries) :
    (id, .entry entry.node (if revoked id then false else entry.valid)) ∈
      (store.invalidate revoked).nodes.entries := by
  classical
  exact invalidate_entry.mpr ⟨entry, stored, rfl⟩

theorem LeaseStore.revoked_invalid {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} (revokedId : revoked id) :
    ¬ LeaseUsable (store.invalidate revoked) id := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨entry, stored, valid⟩
  obtain ⟨old, _, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp stored
  simp [revokedId] at valid

theorem LeaseStore.invalidation_permanent {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} (stored : (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries)
    (invalid : entry.valid = false) : ¬ LeaseUsable (store.invalidate revoked) id := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨after, found, valid⟩
  obtain ⟨old, before, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp found
  have same := store.nodes.value_unique stored before
  subst old
  simp [invalid] at valid

theorem LeaseStore.not_revoked_usable {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} (usable : LeaseUsable store id) (untouched : ¬ revoked id) :
    LeaseUsable (store.invalidate revoked) id := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨entry, stored, valid⟩ := usable
  exact ⟨.entry entry.node entry.valid,
    by simpa [untouched] using invalidate_stored (revoked := revoked) stored, valid⟩

theorem owner_write_invalidates_root {store : LeaseStore} {object : ObjectId}
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} (stored : (id, entry) ∈ store.nodes.entries)
    (root : entry.node = .root object) : ¬ LeaseUsable (invalidateOwner store object) id :=
  store.revoked_invalid ⟨id, entry, stored, root, Or.inl rfl⟩

theorem lease_write_invalidates_descendant {store : LeaseStore} {authority id : LeaseId}
    (descendant : LeaseAncestor store id authority) :
    ¬ LeaseUsable (invalidateLease store authority) id :=
  store.revoked_invalid descendant

theorem lease_write_preserves_authority {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    {authority : LeaseId} (usable : LeaseUsable store authority) :
    LeaseUsable (invalidateLease store authority) authority :=
  store.not_revoked_usable usable (LeaseAncestor.irreflexive wf authority)

theorem lease_write_preserves_ancestor {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    {authority parent : LeaseId} (usable : LeaseUsable store parent)
    (ancestor : LeaseAncestor store authority parent) :
    LeaseUsable (invalidateLease store authority) parent := by
  apply store.not_revoked_usable usable
  intro descendant
  exact LeaseAncestor.irreflexive wf authority (.trans ancestor descendant)

theorem LeaseParent.invalidate_iff {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {child parent : LeaseId} :
    LeaseParent (store.invalidate revoked) child parent ↔ LeaseParent store child parent := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨stored, member⟩
    obtain ⟨old, found, rfl⟩ := LeaseStore.invalidate_entry.mp stored
    exact .parent found member
  · rintro ⟨stored, member⟩
    exact .parent (LeaseStore.invalidate_stored stored) member

-- A revocation policy must include descendants of every node that it revokes.
theorem LeaseStore.invalidate_wellFormed {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    (closed : ∀ child parent, LeaseParent store child parent → revoked parent → revoked child) :
    (store.invalidate revoked).WellFormed := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro id entry stored
    obtain ⟨old, found, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp stored
    exact wf.bounded _ _ found
  · intro id entry stored parent member
    obtain ⟨old, found, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp stored
    obtain ⟨parentEntry, parentStored, older⟩ := wf.parents _ _ found _ member
    exact ⟨_, invalidate_stored parentStored, older⟩
  · intro id entry parents stored kind
    obtain ⟨old, found, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp stored
    exact wf.subleases _ _ _ found kind
  · intro id entry stored valid parent member
    obtain ⟨old, found, rfl⟩ := invalidate_entry.mp stored
    have untouched : ¬ revoked id := by
      intro revokes
      simp [revokes] at valid
    have wasValid : old.valid = true := by simpa [untouched] using valid
    obtain ⟨parentEntry, parentStored, parentValid⟩ := wf.validity _ _ found wasValid _ member
    have parentUntouched : ¬ revoked parent := fun revokes =>
      untouched (closed id parent (.parent found member) revokes)
    exact ⟨_, invalidate_stored parentStored, by simp [parentUntouched, parentValid]⟩

theorem invalidateOwner_wellFormed {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    (object : ObjectId) : (invalidateOwner store object).WellFormed := by
  apply LeaseStore.invalidate_wellFormed wf
  intro child parent edge revoked
  obtain ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, equal | ancestor⟩ := revoked
  · subst parent
    exact ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, Or.inr (.parent edge)⟩
  · exact ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, Or.inr (.trans (.parent edge) ancestor)⟩

theorem invalidateLease_wellFormed {store : LeaseStore} (wf : store.WellFormed)
    (authority : LeaseId) : (invalidateLease store authority).WellFormed := by
  apply LeaseStore.invalidate_wellFormed wf
  intro child parent edge revoked
  exact .trans (.parent edge) revoked

-- Collection is complete when every remaining node is retained by a slot or a
-- child. Acyclicity ensures that this does not retain a disconnected cycle.
def LeaseCollectionComplete (state : State Primitive) : Prop :=
  ∀ id entry, (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries → LeaseRetained state id

def FullLeaseCleanup (before after : State Primitive) : Prop :=
  CleanupLeases before after ∧ LeaseCollectionComplete after

-- Cleanup cannot delete a lease that is stored, including an invalid one.
theorem cleanup_keeps_stored {before after : State Primitive}
    (step : CleanupLease before after) {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry}
    (stored : StoredLease before id) (found : (id, entry) ∈ before.leases.nodes.entries) :
    (id, entry) ∈ after.leases.nodes.entries := by
  cases step with
  | remove removed removedEntry present unused =>
    have different : id ≠ removed := by
      intro equal
      subst id
      exact unused (Or.inl stored)
    simp [FiniteMap.erase, found, different]

-- A child node holds its parents alive independently of references in slots.
theorem cleanup_keeps_parent {before after : State Primitive}
    (step : CleanupLease before after) {child parent : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry}
    (edge : LeaseParent before.leases child parent)
    (found : (parent, entry) ∈ before.leases.nodes.entries) :
    (parent, entry) ∈ after.leases.nodes.entries := by
  cases step with
  | remove removed removedEntry present unused =>
    have different : parent ≠ removed := by
      intro equal
      subst parent
      exact unused (Or.inr ⟨child, edge⟩)
    simp [FiniteMap.erase, found, different]

theorem cleanup_preserves_counter {before after : State Primitive}
    (steps : CleanupLeases before after) : after.leases.nextId = before.leases.nextId := by
  induction steps with
  | done => rfl
  | next step steps ih =>
    cases step
    exact ih

theorem cleanup_preserves_contents {before after : State Primitive}
    (steps : CleanupLeases before after) :
    after.objects = before.objects ∧ after.variables = before.variables := by
  induction steps with
  | done => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | next step steps ih =>
    cases step
    exact ih

theorem CleanupLease.preserves_wellFormed {before after : State Primitive}
    (step : CleanupLease before after) (wf : before.leases.WellFormed) :
    after.leases.WellFormed := by
  cases step with
  | remove removed removedEntry present unused =>
    constructor
    · intro id entry stored
      have old := (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1
      exact wf.bounded _ _ old
    · intro id entry stored parent member
      have old := (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1
      obtain ⟨parentEntry, parentStored, older⟩ := wf.parents _ _ old _ member
      have different : parent ≠ removed := by
        intro equal
        subst parent
        exact unused (Or.inr ⟨id, .parent old member⟩)
      exact ⟨parentEntry, by simp [FiniteMap.erase, parentStored, different], older⟩
    · intro id entry parents stored kind
      exact wf.subleases _ _ _ (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1 kind
    · intro id entry stored valid parent member
      have old := (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1
      obtain ⟨parentEntry, parentStored, parentValid⟩ := wf.validity _ _ old valid _ member
      have different : parent ≠ removed := by
        intro equal
        subst parent
        exact unused (Or.inr ⟨id, .parent old member⟩)
      exact ⟨parentEntry, by simp [FiniteMap.erase, parentStored, different], parentValid⟩

theorem CleanupLeases.preserves_wellFormed {before after : State Primitive}
    (steps : CleanupLeases before after) (wf : before.leases.WellFormed) :
    after.leases.WellFormed := by
  induction steps with
  | done => exact wf
  | next step steps ih => exact ih (step.preserves_wellFormed wf)

-- Removing an old node never makes its identity eligible for another allocation.
theorem cleanup_does_not_recycle {before after : State Primitive}
    (steps : CleanupLeases before after) (wf : before.leases.WellFormed)
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} (stored : (id, entry) ∈ before.leases.nodes.entries) :
    id ≠ after.leases.freshId := by
  intro equal
  have older := wf.bounded _ _ stored
  have counter := cleanup_preserves_counter steps
  have indices := congrArg LeaseId.index equal
  simp only [LeaseStore.freshId] at indices
  omega

theorem CleanupLease.decreases_count {before after : State Primitive}
    (step : CleanupLease before after) :
    after.leases.nodes.entries.length < before.leases.nodes.entries.length := by
  cases step with
  | remove id entry stored unused =>
    apply List.length_filter_lt_length_iff_exists.mpr
    exact ⟨(id, entry), stored, by simp⟩

-- Complete collection always takes finitely many removals, each reducing the
-- number of nodes. The choice among independent unreferenced leaves is irrelevant
-- to its availability; no particular collection order is prescribed.
theorem full_cleanup_exists (state : State Primitive) :
    ∃ after, FullLeaseCleanup state after := by
  classical
  generalize countEq : state.leases.nodes.entries.length = count
  induction count using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing state with
  | ind count ih =>
    by_cases complete : LeaseCollectionComplete state
    · exact ⟨state, .done state, complete⟩
    · simp only [LeaseCollectionComplete, Classical.not_forall] at complete
      obtain ⟨id, entry, stored, unused⟩ := complete
      let middle : State Primitive := .state state.objects state.variables
        (.store (state.leases.nodes.erase id) state.leases.nextId)
      have step : CleanupLease state middle := .remove state id entry stored unused
      obtain ⟨after, steps, collected⟩ := ih middle.leases.nodes.entries.length
        (by simpa [countEq] using step.decreases_count) middle rfl
      exact ⟨after, .next step steps, collected⟩

-- The roots for garbage collection are references in every initialized slot.
-- Its reachability direction follows lease parents, not object reachability.
def LeaseReachableFromSlot (state : State Primitive) (id : LeaseId) : Prop :=
  StoredLease state id ∨
    ∃ child, StoredLease state child ∧ LeaseAncestor state.leases child id

theorem complete_collection_has_no_garbage {state : State Primitive}
    (wf : state.leases.WellFormed) (complete : LeaseCollectionComplete state)
    {id : LeaseId} {entry : LeaseEntry} (stored : (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries) :
    LeaseReachableFromSlot state id := by
  generalize heightEq : state.leases.nextId - id.index = height
  induction height using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing id entry with
  | ind height ih =>
    rcases complete id entry stored with direct | ⟨child, edge⟩
    · exact Or.inl direct
    · have ancestor : LeaseAncestor state.leases child id := .parent edge
      have older := ancestor.decreases wf
      obtain ⟨childEntry, childStored⟩ : ∃ entry, (child, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries := by
        cases edge with
        | parent found member => exact ⟨_, found⟩
      have bound := wf.bounded _ _ childStored
      have shorter : state.leases.nextId - child.index < height := by omega
      rcases ih _ shorter childStored rfl with direct | ⟨root, rootStored, path⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨child, direct, ancestor⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨root, rootStored, .trans path ancestor⟩

end Dada.Heap

-- Transfer leaves every object allocated and preserves its identity. This alone
-- does not establish rooted liveness for arbitrary field destinations.
theorem MoveReference.liveObjects (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (object : ObjectId) : AllocatedObject after object ↔ AllocatedObject before object := by
  cases before
  cases after
  have keys := congrArg Prod.fst move.preserves_keys
  simp only [storageKeys] at keys
  simp only [AllocatedObject, keys]

-- Every initialized occurrence follows the move, without changing the reference.
theorem MoveReference.transports_slot (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (stored : Heap.readSlot before place = some (.initialized reference)) :
    Heap.readSlot after (if place = source then destination else place) =
      some (.initialized reference) := by
  have referenceAt := readSlot_stored.mp stored
  by_cases atSource : place = source
  · subst place
    simpa only [ite_true] using readSlot_stored.mpr (move.reads_back referenceAt)
  · have notDestination : place ≠ destination := by
      cases move with
      | move _ empty _ _ _ =>
        intro same
        subst place
        exact empty.uninitialized_has_no_reference _ referenceAt
    rw [ite_eq_right atSource]
    apply readSlot_stored.mpr
    exact (move.other_references place _ atSource notDestination).mpr referenceAt

-- Lease identity and validity survive a transfer because the graph is unchanged.
theorem MoveReference.referenceUsable (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (reference : Reference) : ReferenceUsable after reference ↔ ReferenceUsable before reference := by
  simp only [ReferenceUsable, move.preserves_leases]

theorem MoveReference.resolveReference
    (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (resolved : ResolveReference before reference object mode) :
    ResolveReference after reference object mode := by
  exact ⟨resolved.target, resolved.permission, (move.liveObjects object).mpr resolved.live,
    (move.referenceUsable reference).mpr resolved.usable⟩

-- ANCHOR: move_preserves_lease_resolution
example (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (resolved : ResolveReference before reference object mode) :
    ResolveReference after reference object mode ∧ after.leases = before.leases := by
  exact ⟨move.resolveReference resolved, move.preserves_leases⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: move_preserves_lease_resolution

-- Consuming transfer moves the exact reference. Its target, access mode, and
-- optional lease identity are independent of the source and destination places.
-- Authority checks, invalidation, and cleanup belong to the calling operation.
inductive MoveReference : State Primitive → Place → Place → State Primitive → Prop where
  | move
      {before middle after : State Primitive} {source destination : Place}
      {reference : Reference}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
      (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized)
      (different : source ≠ destination)
      (cleared : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some middle)
      (written : writeSlot middle destination (.initialized reference) = some after) :
      MoveReference before source destination after

theorem MoveReference.preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) : OwnershipInvariant after := by
  cases move with
  | move stored empty different cleared written =>
    exact moveSlot_preserves_ownership invariant stored empty different cleared written

-- These lists include allocation order, not just key membership.
def storageKeys (state : State Primitive) : List ObjectId × List VariableId :=
  (state.objects.entries.map Prod.fst, state.variables.entries.map Prod.fst)

private theorem writeSlot_storageKeys {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) :
    storageKeys after = storageKeys before := by
  cases before
  cases after
  exact Prod.ext (writeSlot_preserves_keys written).1 (writeSlot_preserves_keys written).2

theorem MoveReference.preserves_keys {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after) :
    storageKeys after = storageKeys before := by
  cases move with
  | move _ _ _ cleared written =>
    exact (writeSlot_storageKeys written).trans (writeSlot_storageKeys cleared)

theorem MoveReference.preserves_variable_order {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after) :
    after.variables.entries.map Prod.fst = before.variables.entries.map Prod.fst :=
  congrArg Prod.snd move.preserves_keys

theorem MoveReference.preserves_leases {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after) :
    after.leases = before.leases := by
  cases move with
  | move _ _ _ cleared written =>
    exact (writeSlot_preserves_leases written).trans (writeSlot_preserves_leases cleared)

theorem MoveReference.readSlot {before after : State Primitive} {source destination : Place}
    (move : MoveReference before source destination after) {reference : Reference}
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference) (place : Place) :
    readSlot after place =
      if place = destination then some (.initialized reference)
      else if place = source then some .uninitialized
      else readSlot before place := by
  cases move with
  | move original _ _ cleared written =>
    have same := Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique original stored)
    subst_vars
    rw [writeSlot_effects written, writeSlot_effects cleared]

theorem MoveReference.reads_back {before after : State Primitive} {source destination : Place}
    (move : MoveReference before source destination after) {reference : Reference}
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference) :
    ReferenceAt after destination reference := by
  rw [ReferenceAt, ← readSlot_stored, move.readSlot stored]
  simp

theorem MoveReference.source_uninitialized {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after) :
    Stored after source .uninitialized := by
  cases move with
  | move _ _ different cleared written =>
    rw [← readSlot_stored, writeSlot_preserves_other written different,
      writeSlot_reads_back cleared]

theorem MoveReference.other_references {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (place : Place) (reference : Reference)
    (notSource : place ≠ source) (notDestination : place ≠ destination) :
    ReferenceAt after place reference ↔ ReferenceAt before place reference := by
  cases move with
  | move _ empty different cleared written =>
    simp [moveSlot_references empty different cleared written, notSource, notDestination]

variable {Primitive : Type}

-- The source-level operation vocabulary. Composed-path rules are specified
-- separately from the checked direct-slot and graph effects below.
inductive PathOperation where
  | give (source : AccessPath) (destination : VariableId)
  | giveShare (source : AccessPath) (destination : VariableId)
  | lease (source : AccessPath) (destination : VariableId)
  | leaseShare (source : AccessPath) (destination : VariableId)
  | drop (source : AccessPath)

-- A direct borrow creates a root from ownership or a child from a borrow.
-- Projecting through multiple borrowed objects will require all those parents.
def Reference.borrowNode (reference : Reference) : LeaseNode :=
  match reference.lease with
  | none => .root reference.object
  | some id => .sublease [id]

-- This operation borrows a stored reference into an existing empty variable.
-- It does not resolve a compound access path or infer its parent dependencies.
inductive BorrowReference : State Primitive → Place → AccessMode → VariableId → State Primitive → Prop where
  | borrow {before after : State Primitive} {source : Place} {destination : VariableId}
      {reference : Reference} {mode : AccessMode} {id : LeaseId} {leases : LeaseStore}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
      (resolved : ResolveReference before reference reference.object reference.mode)
      (authority : mode = .unique → reference.mode = .unique)
      (allocated : AllocateLease before.leases reference.borrowNode id leases)
      (empty : Stored before (.variable destination) .uninitialized)
      (written : writeSlot (.state before.objects before.variables leases)
        (.variable destination) (.initialized (.borrow mode id reference.object)) = some after) :
      BorrowReference before source mode destination after

-- Ownership does not depend on graph metadata.
theorem OwnershipInvariant.with_leases {before : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) (leases : LeaseStore) :
    OwnershipInvariant (.state before.objects before.variables leases) := by
  apply invariant.transport
  · intro place reference
    cases before
    cases place <;> rfl
  · intro object
    cases before
    rfl

theorem BorrowReference.preserves_ownership
    (step : BorrowReference before source mode destination after)
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) : OwnershipInvariant after := by
  cases step with
  | borrow _ _ _ _ empty written =>
    apply initializeBorrow_preserves_ownership (invariant.with_leases _) _ _ written
    · cases before
      exact empty
    · intro object
      simp [Reference.borrow, Reference.owned, Reference.showned]

theorem BorrowReference.preserves_variable_order
    (step : BorrowReference before source mode destination after) :
    variableOrder after = variableOrder before := by
  cases step with
  | borrow _ _ _ _ _ written =>
    simpa [variableOrder] using writeSlot_variableOrder written

-- These are the currently defined machine effects. Invalidation prepares a
-- checked write; updating an object's data is a separate, forthcoming operation.
inductive MachineOperation (Primitive : Type) where
  | heap (operation : Operation Primitive)
  | move (source destination : VariableId)
  | borrow (source : VariableId) (mode : AccessMode) (destination : VariableId)
  | invalidateForWrite (source : VariableId)
  | cleanupLease

inductive MachineStep : State Primitive → MachineOperation Primitive → State Primitive → Prop where
  | heap (step : Step Primitive before operation after) :
      MachineStep before (.heap operation) after
  | move (usable : ResolvePlace before (.variable source) reference)
      (moved : MoveReference before (.variable source) (.variable destination) after) :
      MachineStep before (.move source destination) after
  | borrow (borrowed : BorrowReference before (.variable source) mode destination after) :
      MachineStep before (.borrow source mode destination) after
  | invalidateForWrite (stored : ReferenceAt before (.variable source) reference)
      (resolved : ResolveReference before reference reference.object .unique)
      (invalidated : LeaseWrite before.leases reference leases) :
      MachineStep before (.invalidateForWrite source)
        (.state before.objects before.variables leases)
  | cleanupLease (cleaned : CleanupLease before after) :
      MachineStep before .cleanupLease after

theorem MachineStep.preserves_ownership
    (step : MachineStep before operation after) (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  cases step with
  | heap step => exact step_preserves_ownership invariant step
  | move _ moved => exact moved.preserves_ownership invariant
  | borrow borrowed => exact borrowed.preserves_ownership invariant
  | invalidateForWrite _ _ _ => exact invariant.with_leases _
  | cleanupLease cleaned =>
    cases cleaned
    exact invariant.with_leases _

inductive MachineReachable : State Primitive → Prop where
  | initial : MachineReachable (State.initial Primitive)
  | step (before : MachineReachable state) (next : MachineStep state operation after) :
      MachineReachable after

theorem machineReachable_preserves_ownership (reachable : MachineReachable state) :
    OwnershipInvariant state := by
  induction reachable with
  | initial => exact initial_ownershipInvariant _
  | step _ next ih => exact next.preserves_ownership ih

theorem machineReachable_has_owner (reachable : MachineReachable state)
    (live : AllocatedObject state object) : ∃ place, OwnerAt state place object :=
  (machineReachable_preserves_ownership reachable).hasOwner object live

end Dada.Heap

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}

-- Storage effects connect executable slot updates to occurrence-based ownership.
-- These helpers do not grant permission to access a place or validate a lease.
theorem readSlot_stored {state : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot} :
    readSlot state place = some slot ↔ Stored state place slot := by
  cases state with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id => exact readSlot_variable_iff objects variables id slot
    | field id name => exact readSlot_field_iff objects variables id name slot
    | element id index => exact readSlot_element_iff objects variables id index slot

theorem writeSlot_references {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after)
    (other : Place) (reference : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt after other reference ↔
      (other = place ∧ slot = .initialized reference) ∨
        (other ≠ place ∧ ReferenceAt before other reference) := by
  unfold ReferenceAt
  rw [← readSlot_stored, writeSlot_effects written other]
  by_cases same : other = place
  · simp [same]
  · simp [same, readSlot_stored]

theorem writeSlot_liveObjects {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) (id : ObjectId) :
    AllocatedObject after id ↔ AllocatedObject before id := by
  cases before with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases after with
    | state objects' variables' leases' =>
      have keys := (writeSlot_preserves_keys written).1
      simp only [AllocatedObject, keys]

theorem initializeSlot_references {before after : State Primitive}
    {destination : Place} {reference : Reference}
    (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized)
    (written : writeSlot before destination (.initialized reference) = some after)
    (place : Place) (result : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt after place result ↔
      (place = destination ∧ result = reference) ∨ ReferenceAt before place result := by
  rw [writeSlot_references written]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨same, equal⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨same, (Slot.initialized.inj equal).symm⟩
    · exact Or.inr old
  · rintro (⟨same, equal⟩ | old)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨same, congrArg Slot.initialized equal.symm⟩
    · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, old⟩
      intro same
      subst place
      have impossible := Stored.value_unique old empty
      cases impossible

theorem clearSlot_references {before after : State Primitive} {source : Place}
    (written : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some after)
    (place : Place) (reference : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt after place reference ↔
      place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place reference := by
  rw [writeSlot_references written]
  simp

theorem moveSlot_references {before middle after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} {reference : Reference}
    (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized) (different : source ≠ destination)
    (cleared : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some middle)
    (written : writeSlot middle destination (.initialized reference) = some after)
    (place : Place) (result : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt after place result ↔
      (place = destination ∧ result = reference) ∨
        (place ≠ source ∧ ReferenceAt before place result) := by
  have emptyMiddle : Stored middle destination .uninitialized := by
    rw [← readSlot_stored, writeSlot_preserves_other cleared (Ne.symm different)]
    exact readSlot_stored.mpr empty
  rw [initializeSlot_references emptyMiddle written, clearSlot_references cleared]

theorem initializeBorrow_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {destination : Place} {reference : Reference}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized)
    (nonowning : ∀ id, reference ≠ .owned id ∧ reference ≠ .showned id)
    (written : writeSlot before destination (.initialized reference) = some after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  exact invariant.addBorrow destination reference nonowning
    (initializeSlot_references empty written) (writeSlot_liveObjects written)

theorem moveSlot_preserves_ownership {before middle after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} {reference : Reference}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
    (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized) (different : source ≠ destination)
    (cleared : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some middle)
    (written : writeSlot middle destination (.initialized reference) = some after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  apply invariant.move source destination reference stored
    (moveSlot_references empty different cleared written)
  intro id
  exact (writeSlot_liveObjects written id).trans (writeSlot_liveObjects cleared id)

theorem duplicateShared_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {source destination : Place} {id : ObjectId}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
    (empty : Stored before destination .uninitialized)
    (written : writeSlot before destination (.initialized (.showned id)) = some after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  exact invariant.duplicateShared source destination id stored
    (initializeSlot_references empty written) (writeSlot_liveObjects written)

theorem clearBorrow_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {source : Place} {reference : Reference}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source reference)
    (nonowning : ∀ id, reference ≠ .owned id ∧ reference ≠ .showned id)
    (written : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  exact invariant.removeBorrow source reference stored nonowning
    (clearSlot_references written) (writeSlot_liveObjects written)

theorem releaseShared_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {source other : Place} {id : ObjectId}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
    (remaining : ReferenceAt before other (.showned id)) (different : other ≠ source)
    (written : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some after) :
    OwnershipInvariant after := by
  exact invariant.releaseShared source other id stored remaining different
    (clearSlot_references written) (writeSlot_liveObjects written)

end Dada.Heap
