import Destruction

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}
variable {leases leases' : LeaseStore}

-- The resource-effect layer acts on already selected places. It deliberately
-- does not extend Step: path permissions and lease invalidation must be supplied
-- by the access layer before these effects become complete machine operations.
-- Storage effects do not allocate lease nodes, validate access, or collect leases.
-- A source operation must perform those steps around these bookkeeping effects.
inductive PlaceOperation where
  | give (source : Place) (destination : VariableId)
  | storeBorrow (mode : AccessMode) (lease : LeaseId) (object : ObjectId)
      (destination : VariableId)
  | duplicateShared (source : Place) (destination : VariableId)
  | drop (source : Place)

inductive PlaceEffect : State Primitive → PlaceOperation → State Primitive → Prop where
  | giveOwned
      {before middle after : State Primitive} {source : Place}
      {destination : VariableId} {id : ObjectId}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.owned id))
      (empty : Stored before (.variable destination) .uninitialized)
      (different : source ≠ .variable destination)
      (cleared : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some middle)
      (written : writeSlot middle (.variable destination) (.initialized (.owned id)) = some after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.give source destination) after
  | storeBorrow
      {before after : State Primitive} {mode : AccessMode} {lease : LeaseId}
      {id : ObjectId} {destination : VariableId}
      (empty : Stored before (.variable destination) .uninitialized)
      (written : writeSlot before (.variable destination)
        (.initialized (.borrow mode lease id)) = some after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.storeBorrow mode lease id destination) after
  | duplicateShared
      {before after : State Primitive} {source : Place}
      {destination : VariableId} {id : ObjectId}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
      (empty : Stored before (.variable destination) .uninitialized)
      (written : writeSlot before (.variable destination) (.initialized (.showned id)) = some after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.duplicateShared source destination) after
  | dropBorrow
      {before after : State Primitive} {source : Place}
      {mode : AccessMode} {lease : LeaseId} {id : ObjectId}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.borrow mode lease id))
      (written : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.drop source) after
  | dropShowned
      {before after : State Primitive} {source other : Place} {id : ObjectId}
      (stored : ReferenceAt before source (.showned id))
      (remaining : ReferenceAt before other (.showned id))
      (different : other ≠ source)
      (written : writeSlot before source .uninitialized = some after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.drop source) after

  | dropLeaf
      {before after : State Primitive} {source : Place} {id : ObjectId}
      (released : DropLeaf before source id after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.drop source) after
  | dropChild
      {before middle after : State Primitive} {source child : Place} {id : ObjectId}
      (owner : OwnerAt before source id)
      (lastOwner : ∀ place, OwnerAt before place id → place = source)
      (inside : WithinObject child id)
      (childEffect : PlaceEffect before (.drop child) middle)
      (rest : PlaceEffect middle (.drop source) after) :
      PlaceEffect before (.drop source) after

theorem placeEffect_preserves_ownership {before after : State Primitive}
    {operation : PlaceOperation} (invariant : OwnershipInvariant before)
    (effect : PlaceEffect before operation after) : OwnershipInvariant after := by
  induction effect with
  | giveOwned stored empty different cleared written =>
    exact moveSlot_preserves_ownership invariant stored empty different cleared written
  | storeBorrow empty written =>
    exact initializeBorrow_preserves_ownership invariant empty
      (by intro id; simp [Reference.borrow, Reference.owned, Reference.showned]) written
  | duplicateShared stored empty written =>
    exact duplicateShared_preserves_ownership invariant stored empty written
  | dropBorrow stored written =>
    exact clearBorrow_preserves_ownership invariant stored
      (by intro id; simp [Reference.borrow, Reference.owned, Reference.showned]) written
  | dropShowned stored remaining different written =>
    exact releaseShared_preserves_ownership invariant stored remaining different written
  | dropLeaf released => exact released.preserves_ownership invariant
  | dropChild _ _ _ _ _ childIH restIH => exact restIH (childIH invariant)

-- Reference operations do not allocate, pop, or reorder variable lifetimes.
def variableOrder : State Primitive → List VariableId
  | .state _ variables _ => variables.entries.map Prod.fst

theorem writeSlot_variableOrder {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) :
    variableOrder after = variableOrder before := by
  cases before
  cases after
  exact writeSlot_preserves_variable_order written

theorem placeEffect_preserves_variable_order {before after : State Primitive}
    {operation : PlaceOperation} (effect : PlaceEffect before operation after) :
    variableOrder after = variableOrder before := by
  induction effect with
  | giveOwned _ _ _ cleared written =>
    exact (writeSlot_variableOrder written).trans (writeSlot_variableOrder cleared)
  | storeBorrow _ written | duplicateShared _ _ written | dropBorrow _ written
  | dropShowned _ _ _ written => exact writeSlot_variableOrder written
  | dropLeaf released =>
    cases before
    cases after
    exact released.preserves_variable_order
  | dropChild _ _ _ _ _ childIH restIH => exact restIH.trans childIH

-- This is an object-map equality, including all object contents; it is stronger than
-- merely preserving the set of object identities for this variable-to-variable case.
theorem give_variable_preserves_objects
    {objects objects' : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive)}
    {variables variables' : FiniteMap VariableId Slot} {source destination : VariableId}
    (effect : PlaceEffect (.state objects variables leases)
      (.give (.variable source) destination) (.state objects' variables' leases')) :
    objects' = objects := by
  cases effect with
  | giveOwned stored _ _ cleared written =>
    have found := readSlot_stored.mpr stored
    simp only [readSlot] at found
    simp [writeSlot, found] at cleared
    subst_vars
    cases destFound : (variables.replace source .uninitialized).lookup destination with
    | none => simp [writeSlot, destFound] at written
    | some old =>
      simp [writeSlot, destFound] at written
      exact written.1.symm

end Dada.Heap

import Heap

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}
variable {leases leases' : LeaseStore}

deriving instance DecidableEq for Place

-- Lookup distinguishes a missing slot from a present, uninitialized slot.
def FiniteMap.lookup [DecidableEq Key] (map : FiniteMap Key Value) (key : Key) :
    Option Value := map.entries.lookup key

theorem FiniteMap.lookup_eq_some [DecidableEq Key] (map : FiniteMap Key Value)
    {key : Key} {value : Value} :
    map.lookup key = some value ↔ (key, value) ∈ map.entries := by
  constructor
  · intro found
    obtain ⟨before, after, entries, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
    simp [entries]
  · intro member
    have presentSome : (map.lookup key).isSome := by
      apply List.lookup_isSome_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨(key, value), member, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨found, equal⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp presentSome
    obtain ⟨before, after, entries, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp equal
    have present : (key, found) ∈ map.entries := by simp [entries]
    have same := map.value_unique present member
    simpa [same] using equal

private theorem lookup_replaced [DecidableEq Key] (entries : List (Key × Value))
    (key other : Key) (value : Value) :
    (entries.map fun entry =>
      (entry.1, if entry.1 = key then value else entry.2)).lookup other =
      if other = key then (entries.lookup key).map (fun _ => value)
      else entries.lookup other := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp
  | cons entry entries ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨head, previous⟩
    by_cases same : other = key
    · subst other
      by_cases hit : key = head
      · subst head
        simp
      · simp [List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hit, Ne.symm hit, ih]
    · by_cases hit : other = head
      · subst head
        simp [same]
      · simp [List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hit, same, ih]

theorem FiniteMap.lookup_replace [DecidableEq Key] (map : FiniteMap Key Value)
    (key other : Key) (value : Value) :
    (map.replace key value).lookup other =
      if other = key then (map.lookup key).map (fun _ => value)
      else map.lookup other := lookup_replaced map.entries key other value

-- These are storage operations, not permission checks. Access-path resolution
-- must separately establish the authority to read or replace the chosen slot.
def readSlot : State Primitive → Place → Option Slot
  | .state _ variables _, .variable id => variables.lookup id
  | .state objects _ _, .field id name => do
      let .aggregate fields ← objects.lookup id | none
      fields.lookup name
  | .state objects _ _, .element id index => do
      let .array elements ← objects.lookup id | none
      elements[index]?

-- A write never creates a variable, field, or array element. It changes only
-- an existing slot; missing objects, wrong shapes, and bad indices return none.
def writeSlot : State Primitive → Place → Slot → Option (State Primitive)
  | .state objects variables leases, .variable id, slot => do
      let _ ← variables.lookup id
      some (.state objects (variables.replace id slot) leases)
  | .state objects variables leases, .field id name, slot => do
      let .aggregate fields ← objects.lookup id | none
      let _ ← fields.lookup name
      some (.state (objects.replace id (.aggregate (fields.replace name slot))) variables leases)
  | .state objects variables leases, .element id index, slot => do
      let .array elements ← objects.lookup id | none
      if bounds : index < elements.size then
        some (.state (objects.replace id (.array (elements.set index slot bounds))) variables leases)
      else none

theorem readSlot_variable_iff (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive))
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot) (id : VariableId) (slot : Slot) :
    readSlot (.state objects variables leases) (.variable id) = some slot ↔
      (id, slot) ∈ variables.entries := FiniteMap.lookup_eq_some variables

theorem readSlot_field_iff (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive))
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot) (id : ObjectId) (name : FieldName) (slot : Slot) :
    readSlot (.state objects variables leases) (.field id name) = some slot ↔
      ∃ fields, (id, Object.aggregate fields) ∈ objects.entries ∧
        (name, slot) ∈ fields.entries := by
  simp only [readSlot, bind, Option.bind_eq_some_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨object, found, field⟩
    cases object with
    | primitive value => simp at field
    | array elements => simp at field
    | aggregate fields =>
      exact ⟨fields, objects.lookup_eq_some.mp found, fields.lookup_eq_some.mp field⟩
  · rintro ⟨fields, found, field⟩
    exact ⟨.aggregate fields, objects.lookup_eq_some.mpr found, fields.lookup_eq_some.mpr field⟩

theorem readSlot_element_iff (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive))
    (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot) (id : ObjectId) (index : Nat) (slot : Slot) :
    readSlot (.state objects variables leases) (.element id index) = some slot ↔
      ∃ elements, (id, Object.array elements) ∈ objects.entries ∧
        elements[index]? = some slot := by
  simp only [readSlot, bind, Option.bind_eq_some_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨object, found, element⟩
    cases object with
    | primitive value => simp at element
    | aggregate fields => simp at element
    | array elements => exact ⟨elements, objects.lookup_eq_some.mp found, element⟩
  · rintro ⟨elements, found, element⟩
    exact ⟨.array elements, objects.lookup_eq_some.mpr found, element⟩

theorem writeSlot_effects {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) (other : Place) :
    readSlot after other = if other = place then some slot else readSlot before other := by
  cases before with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id =>
      cases found : variables.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | some previous =>
        simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        cases written
        cases other <;> simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, found]
    | field id name =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | array elements => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | aggregate fields =>
          cases fieldFound : fields.lookup name with
          | none => simp [writeSlot, found, fieldFound] at written
          | some previous =>
            simp [writeSlot, found, fieldFound] at written
            cases written
            cases other with
            | «variable» other => simp [readSlot]
            | field other otherName =>
              by_cases same : other = id
              · subst other
                simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, found, fieldFound]
              · simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, same]
            | element other otherIndex =>
              by_cases same : other = id
              · subst other
                simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, found]
              · simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, same]
    | element id index =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | aggregate fields => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | array elements =>
          by_cases bounds : index < elements.size
          · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written
            cases written
            cases other with
            | «variable» other => simp [readSlot]
            | field other otherName =>
              by_cases same : other = id
              · subst other
                simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, found]
              · simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, same]
            | element other otherIndex =>
              by_cases same : other = id
              · subst other
                simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, found, Array.getElem?_set, eq_comm]
              · simp [readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_replace, same]
          · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written

theorem writeSlot_reads_back {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) : readSlot after place = some slot := by
  simpa using writeSlot_effects written place

theorem writeSlot_preserves_other {before after : State Primitive}
    {place other : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) (different : other ≠ place) :
    readSlot after other = readSlot before other := by
  simpa [different] using writeSlot_effects written other

theorem writeSlot_isSome_iff (state : State Primitive) (place : Place) (slot : Slot) :
    (writeSlot state place slot).isSome ↔ (readSlot state place).isSome := by
  cases state with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id =>
      cases found : variables.lookup id <;> simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
    | field id name =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
        | array elements => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
        | aggregate fields =>
          cases fieldFound : fields.lookup name <;> simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found, fieldFound]
    | element id index =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
        | aggregate fields => simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found]
        | array elements =>
          by_cases bounds : index < elements.size
          · simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found, bounds]
          · simp [writeSlot, readSlot, found, bounds]

theorem writeSlot_none_iff (state : State Primitive) (place : Place) (slot : Slot) :
    writeSlot state place slot = none ↔ readSlot state place = none := by
  have same := writeSlot_isSome_iff state place slot
  cases written : writeSlot state place slot <;> cases read : readSlot state place <;>
    simp_all

-- Allocation order and the set of allocated objects are independent of slot
-- contents: no storage write changes either sequence of identities.
theorem writeSlot_preserves_keys
    {objects objects' : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive)}
    {variables variables' : FiniteMap VariableId Slot} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot (.state objects variables leases) place slot =
      some (.state objects' variables' leases')) :
    objects'.entries.map Prod.fst = objects.entries.map Prod.fst ∧
      variables'.entries.map Prod.fst = variables.entries.map Prod.fst := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» id =>
    cases found : variables.lookup id with
    | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
    | some previous =>
      simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      rcases written with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      simp [FiniteMap.replace_keys]
  | field id name =>
    cases found : objects.lookup id with
    | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
    | some object =>
      cases object with
      | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | array elements => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | aggregate fields =>
        cases fieldFound : fields.lookup name with
        | none => simp [writeSlot, found, fieldFound] at written
        | some previous =>
          simp [writeSlot, found, fieldFound] at written
          rcases written with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
          simp [FiniteMap.replace_keys]
  | element id index =>
    cases found : objects.lookup id with
    | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
    | some object =>
      cases object with
      | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | aggregate fields => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | array elements =>
        by_cases bounds : index < elements.size
        · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written
          rcases written with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
          simp [FiniteMap.replace_keys]
        · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written

theorem writeSlot_preserves_variable_order
    {objects objects' : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive)}
    {variables variables' : FiniteMap VariableId Slot} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot (.state objects variables leases) place slot =
      some (.state objects' variables' leases')) :
    variables'.entries.map Prod.fst = variables.entries.map Prod.fst :=
  (writeSlot_preserves_keys written).2

theorem writeSlot_preserves_leases {before after : State Primitive} {place : Place} {slot : Slot}
    (written : writeSlot before place slot = some after) : after.leases = before.leases := by
  cases before with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id =>
      cases found : variables.lookup id <;> simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      cases written
      rfl
    | field id name =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | array elements => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | aggregate fields =>
          cases fieldFound : fields.lookup name <;> simp [writeSlot, found, fieldFound] at written
          cases written
          rfl
    | element id index =>
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
      | some object =>
        cases object with
        | primitive value => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | aggregate fields => simp [writeSlot, found] at written
        | array elements =>
          by_cases bounds : index < elements.size
          · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written
            cases written
            rfl
          · simp [writeSlot, found, bounds] at written

end Dada.Heap

import PlaceEffects

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}
variable {leases : LeaseStore}

-- Mapping values leaves the keys and their allocation order unchanged.
def FiniteMap.mapValues (f : Value → Result) (map : FiniteMap Key Value) :
    FiniteMap Key Result where
  entries := map.entries.map fun entry => (entry.1, f entry.2)
  uniqueKeys := by
    simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using map.uniqueKeys

@[simp] theorem FiniteMap.mapValues_keys (f : Value → Result) (map : FiniteMap Key Value) :
    (map.mapValues f).entries.map Prod.fst = map.entries.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [mapValues, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

private theorem lookup_mappedEntries [DecidableEq Key] (f : Value → Result)
    (entries : List (Key × Value)) (key : Key) :
    (entries.map fun entry => (entry.1, f entry.2)).lookup key =
      (entries.lookup key).map f := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp
  | cons entry entries ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨head, value⟩
    by_cases same : key = head
    · subst head
      simp
    · simp [List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr same, ih]

@[simp] theorem FiniteMap.lookup_mapValues [DecidableEq Key] (f : Value → Result)
    (map : FiniteMap Key Value) (key : Key) :
    (map.mapValues f).lookup key = (map.lookup key).map f :=
  lookup_mappedEntries f map.entries key

def Slot.mapReferences (f : Reference → Reference) : Slot → Slot
  | .uninitialized => .uninitialized
  | .initialized reference => .initialized (f reference)

def Object.mapReferences (f : Reference → Reference) : Object Primitive → Object Primitive
  | .primitive value => .primitive value
  | .aggregate fields => .aggregate (fields.mapValues (Slot.mapReferences f))
  | .array elements => .array (elements.map (Slot.mapReferences f))

-- This is a simultaneous transformation of every stored reference, including
-- references in fields and array elements. It neither creates nor removes slots.
def mapReferences (f : Reference → Reference) : State Primitive → State Primitive
  | .state objects variables leases =>
      .state (objects.mapValues (Object.mapReferences f))
        (variables.mapValues (Slot.mapReferences f)) leases

theorem mapReferences_keys (f : Reference → Reference)
    (objects : FiniteMap ObjectId (Object Primitive)) (variables : FiniteMap VariableId Slot) :
    let .state objects' variables' _ := mapReferences f (.state objects variables leases)
    objects'.entries.map Prod.fst = objects.entries.map Prod.fst ∧
      variables'.entries.map Prod.fst = variables.entries.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [mapReferences]

theorem readSlot_mapReferences (f : Reference → Reference) (state : State Primitive)
    (place : Place) :
    readSlot (mapReferences f state) place =
      (readSlot state place).map (Slot.mapReferences f) := by
  cases state with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» id => simp [mapReferences, readSlot]
    | field id name =>
      simp only [mapReferences, readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_mapValues]
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => rfl
      | some object =>
        cases object <;> simp [Object.mapReferences]
    | element id index =>
      simp only [mapReferences, readSlot, FiniteMap.lookup_mapValues]
      cases found : objects.lookup id with
      | none => rfl
      | some object =>
        cases object <;> simp [Object.mapReferences]

theorem mapReferences_liveObjects (f : Reference → Reference) (state : State Primitive)
    (id : ObjectId) : AllocatedObject (mapReferences f state) id ↔ AllocatedObject state id := by
  cases state
  simp [mapReferences, AllocatedObject]

theorem mapReferences_references (f : Reference → Reference) (state : State Primitive)
    (place : Place) (reference : Reference) :
    ReferenceAt (mapReferences f state) place reference ↔
      ∃ previous, ReferenceAt state place previous ∧ f previous = reference := by
  simp only [ReferenceAt, ← readSlot_stored, readSlot_mapReferences]
  cases found : readSlot state place with
  | none => simp
  | some slot =>
    cases slot <;> simp [Slot.mapReferences]

-- A reference transformation may change borrows freely but must preserve, and
-- never manufacture, each owning reference to use this ownership theorem.
def PreservesOwners (f : Reference → Reference) : Prop :=
  (∀ reference id, f reference = .owned id ↔ reference = .owned id) ∧
    (∀ reference id, f reference = .showned id ↔ reference = .showned id)

theorem mapReferences_preserves_ownership (f : Reference → Reference)
    (preserves : PreservesOwners f) {state : State Primitive}
    (invariant : OwnershipInvariant state) : OwnershipInvariant (mapReferences f state) := by
  apply invariant.transportOwners
  · intro place id
    rw [mapReferences_references]
    simp only [preserves.1]
    simp
  · intro place id
    rw [mapReferences_references]
    simp only [preserves.2]
    simp
  · exact mapReferences_liveObjects f state

-- Lease identities are independent of storage locations. Moving a reference does
-- not use mapReferences and never rewrites its lease or the lease DAG.
end Dada.Heap

-- Taking a reference never changes an object's class or field domain. Every
-- owner remaining in a field was already present in that same field.
theorem Take.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (taken : Take before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        (name, some target) ∈ oldData.fields := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member ⊢
        rcases member with member | impossible | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · have : some target = none := congrArg Prod.snd impossible
          contradiction
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩

-- Promotion preserves every field target, while changing a unique final
-- reference into shared ownership at the same slot.
theorem Promote.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (promoted : Promote before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        ∃ oldTarget, (name, some oldTarget) ∈ oldData.fields ∧ target.object = oldTarget.object := by
  cases promoted with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl,
        fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member
        rcases member with member | promotedField | member
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl⟩
        · cases promotedField
          exact ⟨.owned object, by simp, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩

end Dada.Shared

    [("u", some (.shared 0)), ("s", some (.shared 1)), ("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩

def sharingCode : List Statement :=
  [⟨"t", .new "Token" []⟩, ⟨"b", .new "Box" ["t"]⟩,
    ⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩,
    ⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩,
    ⟨"v", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩]

theorem example_create_token (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨State.empty, ⟨"t", .new "Token" []⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨tokenState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.new (declaration := ⟨[]⟩) (references := []) (remaining := [])
  · simp [State.empty]
  · simp [exampleClasses]
  · exact Capture.nil []
  · rfl

theorem example_create_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨tokenState, ⟨"b", .new "Box" ["t"]⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨boxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.new (declaration := ⟨["value"]⟩) (references := [.owned 0])
    (remaining := [("t", none)])
  · simp [tokenState]
  · simp [exampleClasses]
  · exact Capture.unique [] [] "t" 0 (Capture.nil [("t", none)])
  · rfl

theorem example_share_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨boxState, ⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨sharedBoxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.giveShare (reference := .owned 1)
    (evaluated := ⟨boxState.objects, [("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩)
  · simp [boxState]
  · apply Give.move (source := .variable "b")
    · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [boxState])
    · exact Take.variable boxState.objects 2 [] [("t", none)] "b" 1

theorem example_copy_field (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨sharedBoxState, ⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨copiedState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.give (reference := .shared 0)
    (evaluated := ⟨copiedState.objects, sharedBoxState.variables, 2⟩)
  · simp [sharedBoxState]
  · apply Give.promote (source := .field 1 "value")
    · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .owned 0) (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by simp [sharedBoxState])
      · simp [sharedBoxState, boxState]
      · simp
    · exact Promote.field sharedBoxState.variables 2 [] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
        1 "Box" [] [] "value" 0

theorem example_copy_again (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨copiedState, ⟨"v", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨twiceCopiedState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.give
  · simp [copiedState]
  · apply Give.copy (source := .field 1 "value")
    · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .shared 0) (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by simp [copiedState])
      · simp [copiedState]
      · simp
    · exact ⟨⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩, by simp [copiedState], by simp⟩

-- ANCHOR: share_value
example : Step exampleClasses
    ⟨boxState, [⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩]⟩ ⟨sharedBoxState, []⟩ := by
  exact example_share_box []
-- ANCHOR_END: share_value

-- ANCHOR: shared_field_copy
example : Step exampleClasses
    ⟨sharedBoxState, [⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩]⟩ ⟨copiedState, []⟩ := by
  exact example_copy_field []
-- ANCHOR_END: shared_field_copy

-- ANCHOR: sharing_execution
example : Steps exampleClasses ⟨State.empty, sharingCode⟩ ⟨twiceCopiedState, []⟩ := by
  exact .step (example_create_token _)
    (.step (example_create_box _) (.step (example_share_box _)
      (.step (example_copy_field _) (.step (example_copy_again _) (.refl _)))))
-- ANCHOR_END: sharing_execution

-- A unique outer Box contains a shared reference to the inner Box. Therefore
-- outer.value.value crosses a shared edge even though outer itself is unique.
def nestedSharedState : State :=
  ⟨(2, ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 1))]⟩) :: boxState.objects,
    ("outer", some (.owned 2)) :: sharedBoxState.variables, 3⟩

def nestedCopiedState : State :=
  ⟨(2, ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 1))]⟩) :: copiedState.objects,
    ("u", some (.shared 0)) :: nestedSharedState.variables, 3⟩

-- ANCHOR: nested_shared_path
example : Steps exampleClasses
    ⟨sharedBoxState, [⟨"outer", .new "Box" ["s"]⟩,
      ⟨"u", .give (.field (.field (.variable "outer") "value") "value")⟩]⟩
    ⟨nestedCopiedState, []⟩ := by
  apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨nestedSharedState,
    [⟨"u", .give (.field (.field (.variable "outer") "value") "value")⟩]⟩)
  · apply Step.new (declaration := ⟨["value"]⟩) (references := [.shared 1])
      (remaining := sharedBoxState.variables)
    · simp [sharedBoxState]
    · simp [exampleClasses]
    · exact Capture.shared [] [("b", none), ("t", none)] "s" 1 (Capture.nil _)
    · rfl
  apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨nestedCopiedState, []⟩)
  · apply Step.give (reference := .shared 0)
      (evaluated := ⟨nestedCopiedState.objects, nestedSharedState.variables, 3⟩)
    · simp [nestedSharedState, sharedBoxState]
    · apply Give.promote (source := .field 1 "value")
      · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .owned 0)
          (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
        · apply Resolve.field (permission := .unique) (reference := .shared 1)
            (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 1))]⟩)
          · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 2) (by simp [nestedSharedState])
          · simp [nestedSharedState, Reference.owned]
          · simp
        · simp [nestedSharedState, boxState]
        · simp
      · exact Promote.field nestedSharedState.variables 3
          [(2, ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 1))]⟩)] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
          1 "Box" [] [] "value" 0
  exact Steps.refl _
-- ANCHOR_END: nested_shared_path

import Shared.Soundness
import Common.Rooted

namespace Dada.Shared

private def VariableRoot (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables ∧ reference.object = object

private def FieldEdge (state : State) (parent object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ data name reference, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
    (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields ∧ reference.object = object

private theorem reference_origin {state : State} {object : ObjectId}
    (member : object ∈ References state) :
    VariableRoot state object ∨ ∃ parent, Allocated state parent ∧ FieldEdge state parent object := by
  simp only [References, List.mem_append, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_flatMap] at member
  rcases member with root | field
  · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩ := root
    obtain ⟨reference, sameSlot, sameTarget⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp value
    dsimp at sameSlot
    subst slot
    exact Or.inl ⟨name, reference, stored, sameTarget⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨parent, data⟩, allocated, ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩⟩ := field
    obtain ⟨reference, sameSlot, sameTarget⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp value
    dsimp at sameSlot
    subst slot
    exact Or.inr ⟨parent, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(parent, data), allocated, rfl⟩,
      data, name, reference, allocated, stored, sameTarget⟩

-- Sharing can introduce several incoming owning edges, but every finite
-- backwards path through fields must still reach a variable root.
theorem WellFormed.allocated_live (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : Live state object := by
  have rooted : Dada.Common.Rooted (VariableRoot state) (FieldEdge state) object :=
    Dada.Common.rooted_of_covered id state.nextId
      (fun node member => by
        obtain ⟨⟨_, data⟩, stored, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
        exact wf.bounds _ data stored)
      (fun node member => reference_origin ((wf.referencesComplete node).mpr member))
      (fun parent node _ edge => by
        obtain ⟨data, name, reference, stored, field, sameTarget⟩ := edge
        simpa [sameTarget] using wf.older parent data name reference stored field)
      object allocated
  clear allocated
  induction rooted with
  | root atRoot =>
    obtain ⟨name, reference, stored, sameTarget⟩ := atRoot
    simpa [sameTarget] using Live.variable stored
  | field _ edge ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, name, reference, stored, field, sameTarget⟩ := edge
    simpa [sameTarget] using Live.field ih stored field

theorem WellFormed.live_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (live : Live state object) : Allocated state object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
  cases live with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field _ stored field =>
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨(_, _), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, _), field, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem WellFormed.live_iff_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    Live state object ↔ Allocated state object :=
  ⟨wf.live_allocated, wf.allocated_live⟩

theorem WellFormed.owner_count_positive (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : 0 < (References state).count object :=
  List.count_pos_iff.mpr ((wf.referencesComplete object).mpr allocated)

-- A unique owner excludes every other owning occurrence, including shared ones.
-- Shared owners are counted separately even when their reference values coincide.
theorem WellFormed.unique_owner_count (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (unique : Reference.owned object ∈ Owners state) :
    (References state).count object = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨leading, trailing, decomposition⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp unique
  have reordered : (Owners state).Perm (Reference.owned object :: (leading ++ trailing)) := by
    rw [decomposition]
    exact List.perm_middle
  have compatible := reordered.pairwise wf.ownersCompatible (by
    intro first second relation
    rcases relation with different | shared
    · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩)
  have absent : object ∉ (leading ++ trailing).map Reference.object := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨reference, found, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have relation := (List.pairwise_cons.mp compatible).1 reference found
    rcases relation with different | shared
    · exact different same.symm
    · cases shared.1
  have targets : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
    simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]
  have counted := (reordered.map Reference.object).count_eq object
  rw [targets] at counted
  rw [counted]
  change (object :: (leading ++ trailing).map Reference.object).count object = 1
  rw [List.count_cons, List.count_eq_zero.mpr absent]
  simp

end Dada.Shared

import Shared.Effects

namespace Dada.Shared

def ClassesWellFormed (classes : Classes) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ name declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.fields.Nodup

-- Each list entry represents one owning occurrence, including repeated shared
-- references stored in different slots.
def Owners (state : State) : List Reference :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))

-- Different occurrences may target the same object only when both are shared.
def Compatible (first second : Reference) : Prop :=
  first.object ≠ second.object ∨ first.mode = .shared ∧ second.mode = .shared

structure WellFormed (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name reference, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → reference.object < id
  ownersCompatible : (Owners state).Pairwise Compatible
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ References state ↔ Allocated state id

private abbrev slotOwners {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List Reference :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

private theorem compatible_symm {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible second first := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩

private theorem compatible_weaken {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible (.shared first.object) second := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl different
  · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, shared.2⟩

private theorem pairwise_weaken (h : (reference :: others).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (Reference.shared reference.object :: others).Pairwise Compatible := by
  exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun _ member => compatible_weaken
    ((List.pairwise_cons.mp h).1 _ member), h.of_cons⟩

private theorem shared_compatible_all {owners : List Reference} (h : owners.Pairwise Compatible)
    (member : Reference.shared object ∈ owners) :
    ∀ reference ∈ owners, Compatible (.shared object) reference := by
  induction owners with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons head tail ih =>
    have parts := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | inside
    · subst head
      intro reference found
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp found with same | rest
      · subst reference
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact parts.1 _ rest
    · intro reference found
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp found with same | rest
      · subst reference
        exact compatible_symm (parts.1 _ inside)
      · exact ih parts.2 inside _ rest

private theorem pairwise_copy {owners : List Reference} (h : owners.Pairwise Compatible)
    (member : Reference.shared object ∈ owners) :
    (Reference.shared object :: owners).Pairwise Compatible :=
  List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨shared_compatible_all h member, h⟩

theorem Take.object_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.variable_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.next_id (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases take <;> rfl

theorem Promote.object_keys (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases promote <;> simp

theorem Promote.variable_keys (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases promote <;> simp

theorem Promote.next_id (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases promote <;> rfl

theorem Take.owners (take : Take before place object after) :
    (Owners before).Perm (Reference.owned object :: Owners after) := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [Owners, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned object)
        (l₁ := slotOwners leading)
        (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [Owners, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned object)
        (l₁ := slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
          slotOwners leading)
        (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))

theorem Promote.owners (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    ∃ rest, (Owners before).Perm (Reference.owned object :: rest) ∧
      (Owners after).Perm (Reference.shared object :: rest) := by
  cases promote with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    refine ⟨slotOwners leading ++ slotOwners suffix ++
      objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields), ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [Owners, List.append_assoc, slotOwners]
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    refine ⟨slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
      slotOwners leading ++ slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields),
      ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simpa [Owners, List.append_assoc, slotOwners] using
        (List.perm_middle
          (l₁ := slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
            slotOwners leading)
          (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))

private theorem stored_owner (stored : Stored state place (some reference)) :
    reference ∈ Owners state := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field object name =>
    obtain ⟨data, member, field⟩ := stored
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(object, data), member,
      List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), field, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem WellFormed.empty (classes : Classes) : WellFormed classes State.empty := by
  constructor <;> simp [State.empty, Owners, References, Allocated]


-- The storage frame records the unchanged identities and layouts. Initialized
-- fields may disappear or weaken to shared ownership, but keep their targets.
private structure StorageFrame (before after : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst
  variableKeys : after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst
  nextId : after.nextId = before.nextId
  data : ∀ id newData, (id, newData) ∈ after.objects →
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      newData.className = oldData.className ∧
      newData.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ newData.fields →
        ∃ oldReference, (name, some oldReference) ∈ oldData.fields ∧
          reference.object = oldReference.object

private theorem Take.frame (take : Take before place object after) : StorageFrame before after := by
  refine ⟨take.object_keys, take.variable_keys, take.next_id, ?_⟩
  intro id data member
  obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, remaining⟩ := take.object_data id data member
  exact ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, fun name reference found =>
    ⟨reference, remaining name reference found, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem Promote.frame (promote : Promote before place object after) : StorageFrame before after :=
  ⟨promote.object_keys, promote.variable_keys, promote.next_id, promote.object_data⟩

private theorem StorageFrame.refl (state : State) : StorageFrame state state := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro id data member
  exact ⟨data, member, rfl, rfl, fun _ reference field => ⟨reference, field, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem Give.frame (give : Give before path reference after) : StorageFrame before after := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take => exact take.frame
  | copy => exact StorageFrame.refl _
  | promote _ promotion => exact promotion.frame

private theorem Give.owners_compatible (give : Give before path reference after)
    (compatible : (Owners before).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (reference :: Owners after).Pairwise Compatible := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take => exact take.owners.pairwise compatible compatible_symm
  | copy _ stored => exact pairwise_copy compatible (stored_owner stored)
  | promote _ promotion =>
    obtain ⟨rest, oldPerm, newPerm⟩ := promotion.owners
    have promoted := pairwise_weaken (oldPerm.pairwise compatible compatible_symm)
    have duplicate := pairwise_copy promoted (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    exact (List.Perm.cons _ newPerm).symm.pairwise duplicate compatible_symm

private theorem Promote.references (promotion : Promote before place object after) :
    References after = References before := by
  cases promotion <;> simp [References, Reference.owned, Reference.shared]

private theorem Give.targets (give : Give before path reference after) (object : ObjectId) :
    object ∈ (reference :: Owners after).map Reference.object ↔ object ∈ References before := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take =>
    simpa [owners_targets] using (take.owners.map Reference.object).mem_iff.symm
  | copy _ stored =>
    have member := List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Reference.object) (stored_owner stored)
    rw [owners_targets] at member
    simp only [List.map_cons, owners_targets, List.mem_cons]
    exact or_iff_right_of_imp (fun same => same ▸ member)
  | promote _ promotion =>
    obtain ⟨rest, oldPerm, _⟩ := promotion.owners
    have present := (oldPerm.map Reference.object).mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [owners_targets] at present
    simp only [List.map_cons, owners_targets, promotion.references, List.mem_cons]
    exact or_iff_right_of_imp (fun same => same ▸ present)

theorem Give.bind_preserves (wf : WellFormed classes before)
    (give : Give before path reference after)
    (fresh : destination ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (after.bind destination reference) := by
  have frame := give.frame
  constructor
  · simpa [State.bind, frame.objectKeys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [State.bind, frame.variableKeys] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    simpa [State.bind, frame.nextId] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro id data name target member field
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, remaining⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨oldTarget, oldField, sameTarget⟩ := remaining name target field
    rw [sameTarget]
    exact wf.older id oldData name oldTarget oldMember oldField
  · simpa [State.bind, Owners] using give.owners_compatible wf.ownersCompatible
  · intro id
    have target := give.targets id
    rw [← owners_targets (after.bind destination reference)]
    simpa [Allocated, State.bind, Owners, frame.objectKeys] using
      target.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)

theorem WellFormed.share_result {state : State} {name : VariableId} {reference : Reference}
    (wf : WellFormed classes (state.bind name reference)) :
    WellFormed classes (state.bind name (.shared reference.object)) := by
  constructor
  · exact wf.objectKeys
  · exact wf.variableKeys
  · exact wf.shapes
  · exact wf.bounds
  · exact wf.older
  · have compatible : (reference :: Owners state).Pairwise Compatible := by
      simpa [Owners, State.bind] using wf.ownersCompatible
    simpa [Owners, State.bind] using pairwise_weaken compatible
  · simpa [References, State.bind, Reference.shared, Allocated] using wf.referencesComplete


theorem Capture.variable_keys (capture : Capture before arguments references after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction capture with
  | nil => rfl
  | unique leading suffix name object _ ih => simpa using ih
  | shared _ _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih

-- Constructor capture preserves ownership compatibility, including owners
-- outside the variable store and references already captured by earlier operands.
private theorem Capture.owners_compatible
    (capture : Capture before arguments references after)
    (outside : List Reference)
    (compatible : (slotOwners before ++ outside).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (references ++ slotOwners after ++ outside).Pairwise Compatible := by
  induction capture generalizing outside with
  | nil => simpa using compatible
  | unique leading suffix name object capture ih =>
    have move : (slotOwners (leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix) ++ outside).Perm
        (Reference.owned object :: (slotOwners (leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix) ++ outside)) := by
      simp [slotOwners, List.append_assoc]
    have front := move.pairwise compatible compatible_symm
    have rotated := (List.perm_middle
      (l₁ := slotOwners (leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix)) (l₂ := outside)).symm.pairwise
      front compatible_symm
    have captured := ih (Reference.owned object :: outside) rotated
    exact (by simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned object)
        (l₁ := _ ++ slotOwners _) (l₂ := outside)).pairwise captured compatible_symm)
  | shared leading suffix name object capture ih =>
    have member : Reference.shared object ∈
        slotOwners (leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix) ++ outside := by
      simp [slotOwners]
    have front := pairwise_copy compatible member
    have rotated := (List.perm_middle
      (l₁ := slotOwners (leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix))
      (l₂ := outside)).symm.pairwise front compatible_symm
    have captured := ih (Reference.shared object :: outside) rotated
    exact (by simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.shared object)
        (l₁ := _ ++ slotOwners _) (l₂ := outside)).pairwise captured compatible_symm)

private theorem Capture.targets (capture : Capture before arguments references after)
    (object : ObjectId) :
    object ∈ (references ++ slotOwners after).map Reference.object ↔
      object ∈ (slotOwners before).map Reference.object := by
  induction capture with
  | nil => simp
  | unique leading suffix name target capture ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons]
    rw [ih]
    simp [slotOwners, List.map_filterMap, or_left_comm,
      Reference.owned]
  | shared leading suffix name target capture ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons]
    rw [ih]
    simp [slotOwners, List.map_filterMap, or_left_comm,
      Reference.shared]

private theorem capture_bound (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments references remaining)
    (member : reference ∈ references) : reference.object < state.nextId := by
  have target := capture.targets reference.object
  have captured : reference.object ∈ (slotOwners state.variables).map Reference.object :=
    target.mp (List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_append_left _ member))
  have referred : reference.object ∈ References state := by
    rw [← owners_targets]
    obtain ⟨ref, stored, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp captured
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨ref, List.mem_append_left _ stored, same⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, equality⟩ :=
    List.mem_map.mp ((wf.referencesComplete reference.object).mp referred)
  simp only at equality
  subst id
  exact wf.bounds reference.object data allocated


private theorem zipped_field_names (fields : List FieldName) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    (fields.zip (references.map some)).map Prod.fst = fields := by
  apply List.map_fst_zip
  simp [lengths]

private theorem zipped_field_owners (fields : List FieldName) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    slotOwners (fields.zip (references.map some)) = references := by
  have seconds := List.map_snd_zip (l₁ := fields) (l₂ := references.map some)
    (by simp [lengths])
  have filtered := congrArg (List.filterMap id) seconds
  simpa [List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def, slotOwners] using filtered

private theorem creation_owners (state : State)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    Owners (state.create remaining destination className fields references) =
      Reference.owned state.nextId ::
        (slotOwners remaining ++ references ++
          state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)) := by
  simp only [Owners, State.create, List.filterMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.cons_append]
  rw [show List.filterMap (fun field => field.2) (fields.zip (references.map some)) = references
    from zipped_field_owners fields references lengths]
  simp [slotOwners, List.append_assoc]

private theorem creation_targets (state : State)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments references remaining)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) (object : ObjectId) :
    object ∈ References (state.create remaining destination className fields references) ↔
      object = state.nextId ∨ object ∈ References state := by
  rw [← owners_targets, creation_owners state lengths]
  have captured := capture.targets object
  simp only [List.map_append, List.mem_append] at captured
  rw [← owners_targets]
  simp only [Owners, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append,
    Reference.owned]
  rw [show (object ∈ List.map Reference.object (slotOwners remaining) ∨
      object ∈ List.map Reference.object references) =
      (object ∈ List.map Reference.object (slotOwners state.variables)) from
      propext (Or.comm.trans captured)]

theorem Capture.create_preserves (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (fresh : destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst)
    (declared : (className, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments references remaining)
    (lengths : references.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    WellFormed classes
      (state.create remaining destination className declaration.fields references) := by
  have freshObject : state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    simp only at same
    subst id
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ (wf.bounds _ _ allocated))
  have freshReference : state.nextId ∉ References state := by
    intro member
    exact freshObject ((wf.referencesComplete _).mp member)
  constructor
  · simpa [State.create] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshObject, wf.objectKeys⟩
  · simpa [State.create, capture.variable_keys] using
      List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact ⟨declaration, declared, zipped_field_names _ _ lengths,
        classesWf.2 _ _ declared⟩
    · exact wf.shapes id data old
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (wf.bounds id data old)
  · intro id data name target member field
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      have referred : target ∈ slotOwners (declaration.fields.zip (references.map some)) :=
        List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩
      rw [zipped_field_owners _ _ lengths] at referred
      exact capture_bound wf capture referred
    · exact wf.older id data name target old field
  · rw [creation_owners state lengths]
    let outside : List Reference := state.objects.flatMap
      (fun entry : ObjectId × Object => slotOwners entry.2.fields)
    have oldCompatible : (slotOwners state.variables ++ outside).Pairwise Compatible :=
      wf.ownersCompatible
    have captured := capture.owners_compatible outside oldCompatible
    have rearranged :=
      ((List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := references) (l₂ := slotOwners remaining)).append_right
        (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields))).pairwise captured compatible_symm
    apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, rearranged⟩
    intro reference member
    apply Or.inl
    intro sameTarget
    have appears : reference.object ∈ References state := by
      have oldCapture := capture.targets reference.object
      have memberTarget := List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Reference.object) member
      simp only [List.map_append, List.mem_append] at memberTarget oldCapture
      rw [← owners_targets]
      simp only [Owners, List.map_append, List.mem_append]
      rcases memberTarget with capturedOrRemaining | stored
      · exact Or.inl (oldCapture.mp capturedOrRemaining.symm)
      · exact Or.inr stored
    have idEqual : reference.object = state.nextId := sameTarget.symm
    exact freshReference (idEqual ▸ appears)
  · intro id
    rw [creation_targets state capture lengths]
    simp only [wf.referencesComplete, Allocated, State.create, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons]

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | give fresh give => exact give.bind_preserves wf fresh
  | giveShare fresh give => exact (give.bind_preserves wf fresh).share_result
  | new fresh declared capture lengths =>
    exact capture.create_preserves classesWf wf fresh declared lengths

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

theorem Steps.from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormed program.classes after.state :=
  steps.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

import Shared.Syntax

namespace Dada.Shared

inductive Mode where
  | unique
  | shared
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Shared access is retained through every remaining projection.
def Mode.join : Mode → Mode → Mode
  | .unique, .unique => .unique
  | _, _ => .shared

structure Reference where
  reference ::
  mode : Mode
  object : ObjectId
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Reference.owned (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.unique, object⟩

def Reference.shared (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.shared, object⟩

-- An empty slot is still allocated, but contributes no owner.
abbrev Slot := Option Reference

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : ObjectId
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2.map Reference.object) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap
      (fun field => field.2.map Reference.object))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables → Live state reference.object
  | field {parent reference data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → Live state reference.object

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Shared

import Shared.State

namespace Dada.Shared

-- Resolve records the effective permission of the whole path. A shared link
-- makes all subsequent access shared, even when a later stored link is unique.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Mode → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) reference.object reference.mode
  | field {base source parent permission data name reference} :
      Resolve state base source parent permission →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) reference.object
        (permission.join reference.mode)

-- Only a unique reference can be taken; copying leaves the source initialized.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

-- A copy of a unique final field through shared access first promotes precisely
-- that stored owner to shared. This changes permissions, not object identity,
-- field names, or the represented field value.
inductive Promote : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

inductive Give : State → Place → Reference → State → Prop where
  | move {state cleared : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .unique →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Give state path (.owned object) cleared
  | copy {state : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Stored state source (some (.shared object)) →
      Give state path (.shared object) state
  | promote {state promoted : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Promote state source object promoted →
      Give state path (.shared object) promoted

-- Constructor operands use the same root-variable behavior as p→: a unique
-- argument is consumed, while a shared argument is copied.
inductive Capture : List (VariableId × Slot) → List VariableId → List Reference → List (VariableId × Slot) → Prop where
  | nil (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) : Capture variables [] [] variables
  | unique (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId)
      {arguments : List VariableId} {references : List Reference}
      {remaining : List (VariableId × Slot)} :
      Capture (leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix) arguments references remaining →
      Capture (leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix) (name :: arguments)
        (.owned object :: references) remaining
  | shared (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId)
      {arguments : List VariableId} {references : List Reference}
      {remaining : List (VariableId × Slot)} :
      Capture (leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix) arguments references remaining →
      Capture (leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix) (name :: arguments)
        (.shared object :: references) remaining

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (reference : Reference) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some reference) :: state.variables }

def State.create (state : State) (variables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (name : VariableId) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (arguments : List Reference) : State :=
  ⟨(state.nextId, ⟨className, fields.zip (arguments.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    (name, some (.owned state.nextId)) :: variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | give {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {path : Place}
      {reference : Reference} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, .give path⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination reference, rest⟩
  | giveShare {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {path : Place}
      {reference : Reference} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, .giveShare path⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination (.shared reference.object), rest⟩
  | new {state : State} {remaining : List (VariableId × Slot)}
      {destination : VariableId} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List VariableId} {references : List Reference} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      Capture state.variables arguments references remaining →
      references.length = declaration.fields.length →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, .new className arguments⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨state.create remaining destination className declaration.fields references, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Shared

-- Taking a reference never changes an object's class or field domain. Every
-- owner remaining in a field was already present in that same field.
theorem Take.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (taken : Take before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        (name, some target) ∈ oldData.fields := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some object) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member ⊢
        rcases member with member | impossible | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · have : some target = none := congrArg Prod.snd impossible
          contradiction
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
