        [("b", some 1), ("t", none)], 2⟩)
    · simp [boxState]
    · apply Resolve.field (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some 0)]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (by simp [boxState])
      · simp [boxState]
      · simp
    · exact Take.field [("b", some 1), ("t", none)] 2 [] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
        1 "Box" [] [] "value" 0
  exact Steps.refl _
-- ANCHOR_END: give_execution

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.Soundness
import Common.Rooted

namespace Dada.Unique

private def VariableRoot (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ name, (name, some object) ∈ state.variables

private def FieldEdge (state : State) (parent object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ data name, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, some object) ∈ data.fields

private theorem reference_origin {state : State} {object : ObjectId}
    (member : object ∈ References state) :
    VariableRoot state object ∨ ∃ parent, Allocated state parent ∧ FieldEdge state parent object := by
  simp only [References, List.mem_append, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_flatMap] at member
  rcases member with root | field
  · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩ := root
    dsimp at value
    subst slot
    exact Or.inl ⟨name, stored⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨parent, data⟩, allocated, ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩⟩ := field
    dsimp at value
    subst slot
    exact Or.inr ⟨parent, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(parent, data), allocated, rfl⟩,
      data, name, allocated, stored⟩

-- The finite allocation order prevents an owner-only cycle from satisfying
-- coverage without any variable root.
theorem WellFormed.allocated_live (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : Live state object := by
  have rooted : Dada.Common.Rooted (VariableRoot state) (FieldEdge state) object :=
    Dada.Common.rooted_of_covered id state.nextId
      (fun node member => by
        obtain ⟨⟨_, data⟩, stored, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
        exact wf.bounds _ data stored)
      (fun node member => reference_origin ((wf.referencesComplete node).mpr member))
      (fun parent node _ edge => by
        obtain ⟨data, name, stored, field⟩ := edge
        exact wf.older parent data name node stored field)
      object allocated
  clear allocated
  induction rooted with
  | root atRoot =>
    obtain ⟨name, stored⟩ := atRoot
    exact .variable stored
  | field _ edge ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, name, stored, field⟩ := edge
    exact .field ih stored field

theorem WellFormed.live_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (live : Live state object) : Allocated state object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
  cases live with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some object), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field _ stored field =>
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨(_, _), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some object), field, rfl⟩⟩)

-- Liveness is a graph property, independent of the transition relation.
theorem WellFormed.live_iff_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    Live state object ↔ Allocated state object :=
  ⟨wf.live_allocated, wf.allocated_live⟩

-- There is exactly one owning occurrence of each allocated object, counted
-- across both variables and object fields.
theorem WellFormed.owner_count (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : (References state).count object = 1 := by
  exact wf.referencesUnique.count_of_mem ((wf.referencesComplete object).mpr allocated)

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.Effects

namespace Dada.Unique

-- Class layouts are fixed, and every field name identifies one slot.
def ClassesWellFormed (classes : Classes) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ name declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.fields.Nodup

-- These conditions describe arbitrary finite graphs independently of execution.
-- The older-target condition is maintained because constructors only capture
-- previously allocated objects; it rules out owning cycles in this language.
structure WellFormed (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name target, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some target) ∈ data.fields → target < id
  referencesUnique : (References state).Nodup
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ References state ↔ Allocated state id

private abbrev slotReferences {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List ObjectId :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

private theorem slotReferences_append {K : Type} (left right : List (K × Slot)) :
    slotReferences (left ++ right) = slotReferences left ++ slotReferences right := by
  simp [slotReferences]

private theorem slotReferences_some {K : Type} (name : K) (object : ObjectId)
    (tail : List (K × Slot)) :
    slotReferences ((name, some object) :: tail) = object :: slotReferences tail := by
  simp [slotReferences]

private theorem slotReferences_none {K : Type} (name : K) (tail : List (K × Slot)) :
    slotReferences ((name, none) :: tail) = slotReferences tail := by
  simp [slotReferences]

-- Taking an owner changes neither object allocation nor slot identities.
theorem Take.object_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.variable_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.next_id (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases take <;> rfl

-- One occurrence leaves the source graph and becomes the expression's result.
theorem Take.references (take : Take before place object after) :
    (References before).Perm (object :: References after) := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := leading.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          before.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2)) ++
          leading.filterMap (fun field => field.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun field => field.2) ++
          after.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))

-- Capturing constructor operands preserves the variable slots while transferring
-- their references into the new object's fields.
theorem Capture.variable_keys (capture : Capture before arguments objects after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction capture with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons leading suffix name object _ ih => simpa using ih

theorem Capture.references (capture : Capture before arguments objects after) :
    (slotReferences before).Perm (objects ++ slotReferences after) := by
  induction capture with
  | nil => simp
  | cons leading suffix name object capture ih =>
    simp only [slotReferences_append, slotReferences_some, slotReferences_none] at ih ⊢
    exact (List.perm_middle (a := object) (l₁ := slotReferences leading)
      (l₂ := slotReferences suffix)).trans (List.Perm.cons object ih)

theorem WellFormed.empty (classes : Classes) : WellFormed classes State.empty := by
  constructor <;> simp [State.empty, References, Allocated]


-- A successful give keeps every existing object and transfers exactly one owner
-- to a new variable. Place resolution supplies its source; no invariant is a
-- premise of the graph operation itself.
theorem Take.bind_preserves (wf : WellFormed classes before)
    (take : Take before place object after)
    (fresh : destination ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (after.bind destination object) := by
  have references : (References before).Perm (References (after.bind destination object)) := by
    simpa [References, State.bind] using take.references
  constructor
  · simpa [State.bind, take.object_keys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [State.bind, take.variable_keys] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    simpa [State.bind, take.next_id] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro id data name target member field
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, remaining⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    exact wf.older id oldData name target oldMember (remaining name target field)
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique
  · intro id
    simpa [Allocated, State.bind, take.object_keys] using
      references.mem_iff.symm.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)

private theorem capture_bound (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments objects remaining)
    (member : object ∈ objects) : object < state.nextId := by
  have captured : object ∈ slotReferences state.variables :=
    capture.references.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_append_left _ member)
  have referred : object ∈ References state := List.mem_append_left _ captured
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, equality⟩ :=
    List.mem_map.mp ((wf.referencesComplete object).mp referred)
  simp only at equality
  subst id
  exact wf.bounds object data allocated

private theorem zipped_field_names (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    (fields.zip (objects.map some)).map Prod.fst = fields := by
  apply List.map_fst_zip
  simp [lengths]

private theorem zipped_field_references (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    slotReferences (fields.zip (objects.map some)) = objects := by
  have seconds := List.map_snd_zip (l₁ := fields) (l₂ := objects.map some)
    (by simp [lengths])
  have filtered := congrArg (List.filterMap id) seconds
  simpa [List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def, slotReferences] using filtered

private theorem creation_references (state : State)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments objects remaining)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    (state.nextId :: References state).Perm
      (References (state.create remaining destination className fields objects)) := by
  have captured := capture.references.append_right
    (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotReferences entry.2.fields))
  have swapped := (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := objects) (l₂ := slotReferences remaining)).append_right
    (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotReferences entry.2.fields))
  have reordered := List.Perm.cons state.nextId (captured.trans swapped)
  simpa [References, State.create, List.append_assoc, slotReferences,
    zipped_field_references fields objects lengths] using reordered

theorem Capture.create_preserves (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (fresh : destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst)
    (declared : (className, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (capture : Capture state.variables arguments objects remaining)
    (lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    WellFormed classes
      (state.create remaining destination className declaration.fields objects) := by
  have freshObject : state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    simp only at same
    subst id
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ (wf.bounds _ _ allocated))
  have freshReference : state.nextId ∉ References state := by
    intro member
    exact freshObject ((wf.referencesComplete _).mp member)
  have references := creation_references state capture lengths
    (destination := destination) (className := className)
  constructor
  · simpa [State.create] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshObject, wf.objectKeys⟩
  · simpa [State.create, capture.variable_keys] using
      List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact ⟨declaration, declared, zipped_field_names _ _ lengths,
        classesWf.2 _ _ declared⟩
    · exact wf.shapes id data old
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (wf.bounds id data old)
  · intro id data name target member field
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      have referred : target ∈ slotReferences (declaration.fields.zip (objects.map some)) :=
        List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩
      rw [zipped_field_references _ _ lengths] at referred
      exact capture_bound wf capture referred
    · exact wf.older id data name target old field
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshReference, wf.referencesUnique⟩)
  · intro id
    rw [← references.mem_iff]
    simp only [List.mem_cons, wf.referencesComplete, Allocated, State.create, List.map_cons]

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | give fresh _ take => exact take.bind_preserves wf fresh
  | new fresh declared capture lengths =>
    exact capture.create_preserves classesWf wf fresh declared lengths

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

theorem Steps.from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormed program.classes after.state :=
  steps.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.Syntax

namespace Dada.Unique

-- A slot is allocated even when it no longer contains an owner.
abbrev Slot := Option ObjectId

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : ObjectId
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables → Live state object
  | field {parent object data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields → Live state object

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.State

namespace Dada.Unique

-- Resolving a place reads the graph without changing any slot.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} :
      (name, some object) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) object
  | field {base source parent data name object} :
      Resolve state base source parent →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) object

-- Removing an owner leaves precisely that allocated slot uninitialized.
-- The list decompositions specify exact effects even on arbitrary raw states.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : ObjectId)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

-- Constructor argument capture is atomic at the statement boundary. A repeated
-- variable cannot be captured twice because its first capture empties the slot.
inductive Capture : List (VariableId × Slot) → List VariableId → List ObjectId → List (VariableId × Slot) → Prop where
  | nil (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) : Capture variables [] [] variables
  | cons (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId)
      {arguments : List VariableId} {objects : List ObjectId}
      {remaining : List (VariableId × Slot)} :
      Capture (leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix) arguments objects remaining →
      Capture (leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix) (name :: arguments)
        (object :: objects) remaining

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some object) :: state.variables }

def State.create (state : State) (variables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (name : VariableId) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (arguments : List ObjectId) : State :=
  ⟨(state.nextId, ⟨className, fields.zip (arguments.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    (name, some state.nextId) :: variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

-- The transition relation has no well-formedness premise. Preservation is a
-- separate theorem about these concrete graph transformations.
inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | give {state cleared : State} {destination : VariableId} {path : Place}
      {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Resolve state path source object →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, .give path⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨cleared.bind destination object, rest⟩
  | new {state : State} {remaining : List (VariableId × Slot)}
      {destination : VariableId} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List VariableId} {objects : List ObjectId} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      Capture state.variables arguments objects remaining →
      objects.length = declaration.fields.length →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, .new className arguments⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨state.create remaining destination className declaration.fields objects, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Unique

import Std

namespace Dada.Unique

abbrev ObjectId := Nat
abbrev VariableId := String
abbrev FieldName := String
abbrev ClassName := String

structure Class where
  fields : List FieldName
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

abbrev Classes := List (ClassName × Class)

-- Places name storage; evaluating a place alone does not produce a value.
inductive Place where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (base : Place) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Constructor operands are variable gives; compound operands are first named
-- by a preceding let. The distinct syntax keeps places separate from values.
inductive Value where
  | give (source : Place)
  | new (className : ClassName) (arguments : List VariableId)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Statement where
  letValue ::
  destination : VariableId
  value : Value
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Program where
  classes : Classes
  body : List Statement
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

end Dada.Unique

import MoveValidity

namespace Dada.Heap

variable {Primitive : Type}

-- Rooted liveness follows owning occurrences, starting at every variable slot.
-- OwnerAt includes both unique and shared ownership, but never a lease.
inductive OwningReachable (state : State Primitive) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable (owner : OwnerAt state (.variable rootVariable) object) :
      OwningReachable state object
  | field (parent : OwningReachable state object)
      (owner : OwnerAt state (.field object name) target) :
      OwningReachable state target
  | element (parent : OwningReachable state object)
      (owner : OwnerAt state (.element object index) target) :
      OwningReachable state target

-- This is structural reference reachability, not an executable access path.
-- Each edge resolves independently; no permission restriction from an earlier
-- edge prevents counting a reference stored inside a reachable object.
inductive ReferenceReachable (state : State Primitive) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable (stored : ReferenceAt state (.variable rootVariable) reference)
      (resolved : ResolveReference state reference object permission) :
      ReferenceReachable state object
  | field (parent : ReferenceReachable state object)
      (stored : ReferenceAt state (.field object name) reference)
      (resolved : ResolveReference state reference target permission) :
      ReferenceReachable state target
  | element (parent : ReferenceReachable state object)
      (stored : ReferenceAt state (.element object index) reference)
      (resolved : ResolveReference state reference target permission) :
      ReferenceReachable state target

-- AllocatedObject means object-map membership.
-- RootedOwnership equates those allocated objects with rooted owning paths.
def RootedOwnership (state : State Primitive) : Prop :=
  ∀ object, AllocatedObject state object ↔ OwningReachable state object

theorem OwnerAt.resolves (ownership : OwnershipInvariant state)
    (owner : OwnerAt state place object) :
    ∃ reference permission, ReferenceAt state place reference ∧
      ResolveReference state reference object permission := by
  have live := ownership.targetsLive place object owner
  rcases owner with unique | shared
  · exact ⟨.owned object, .unique, unique, .owner .unique live⟩
  · exact ⟨.showned object, .shared, shared, .owner .shared live⟩

theorem OwningReachable.referenceReachable (ownership : OwnershipInvariant state)
    (reachable : OwningReachable state object) : ReferenceReachable state object := by
  induction reachable with
  | «variable» owner =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, stored, resolved⟩ := owner.resolves ownership
    exact .variable stored resolved
  | field _ owner ih =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, stored, resolved⟩ := owner.resolves ownership
    exact .field ih stored resolved
  | element _ owner ih =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, stored, resolved⟩ := owner.resolves ownership
    exact .element ih stored resolved

theorem ReferenceReachable.allocated (reachable : ReferenceReachable state object) :
    AllocatedObject state object := by
  cases reachable with
  | «variable» _ resolved => exact resolved.live
  | field _ _ resolved => exact resolved.live
  | element _ _ resolved => exact resolved.live

theorem OwningReachable.allocated (ownership : OwnershipInvariant state)
    (reachable : OwningReachable state object) : AllocatedObject state object :=
  (reachable.referenceReachable ownership).allocated

-- A stored borrow retains its node even after invalidation. Owners need no node.
def ReferenceKnown (state : State Primitive) (reference : Reference) : Prop :=
  match reference.lease with
  | none => True
  | some id => ∃ entry, (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries

-- Invalid borrowers are legal stored values. Only owners and usable borrowers
-- must target allocated objects; allocatedLive then makes those targets live.
structure WellFormed (state : State Primitive) : Prop where
  graph : state.leases.WellFormed
  rootsLive : ∀ id entry object, (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries →
    entry.node = .root object → entry.valid = true → AllocatedObject state object
  allocatedLive : ∀ object, AllocatedObject state object → OwningReachable state object
  slotsValid : ∀ place reference, ReferenceAt state place reference →
    ReferenceKnown state reference ∧ (ReferenceUsable state reference →
      AllocatedObject state reference.object)
  uniqueOwners : ∀ place object, ReferenceAt state place (.owned object) →
    ∀ other, OwnerAt state other object → other = place

theorem WellFormed.reference_live (valid : WellFormed state)
    (stored : ReferenceAt state place reference) (usable : ReferenceUsable state reference) :
    ResolveReference state reference reference.object reference.mode ∧
      OwningReachable state reference.object := by
  have allocated := (valid.slotsValid place reference stored).2 usable
  exact ⟨⟨rfl, rfl, allocated, usable⟩, valid.allocatedLive _ allocated⟩

theorem WellFormed.lease_exists {id : LeaseId} (valid : WellFormed state)
    (stored : ReferenceAt state place reference) (loan : reference.lease = some id) :
    ∃ entry, (id, entry) ∈ state.leases.nodes.entries := by
  have known := (valid.slotsValid place reference stored).1
  simpa only [ReferenceKnown, loan] using known

theorem WellFormed.ownership (valid : WellFormed state) : OwnershipInvariant state := by
  constructor
  · intro place object owner
    rcases owner with unique | shared
    · exact (valid.slotsValid place (.owned object) unique).2 True.intro
    · exact (valid.slotsValid place (.showned object) shared).2 True.intro
  · intro object allocated
    cases valid.allocatedLive object allocated with
    | «variable» owner => exact ⟨_, owner⟩
    | field _ owner => exact ⟨_, owner⟩
    | element _ owner => exact ⟨_, owner⟩
  · intro place other object first second
    exact (valid.uniqueOwners place object first other (Or.inl second)).symm
  · intro place other object unique shared
    have same := valid.uniqueOwners place object unique other (Or.inr shared)
    subst other
    have impossible := Stored.value_unique unique shared
    cases impossible

theorem WellFormed.rootedOwnership (valid : WellFormed state) : RootedOwnership state := by
  intro object
  exact ⟨valid.allocatedLive object, fun reachable => reachable.allocated valid.ownership⟩

theorem WellFormed.reachability_agrees (valid : WellFormed state) :
    (AllocatedObject state object ↔ OwningReachable state object) ∧
    (ReferenceReachable state object ↔ OwningReachable state object) := by
  refine ⟨valid.rootedOwnership object, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro reachable
    exact (valid.rootedOwnership object).mp reachable.allocated
  · intro reachable
    exact reachable.referenceReachable valid.ownership

-- These are consequences of the state-level definition of well-formedness.
-- Their hypotheses make no claim that the state is reachable by current steps.
theorem WellFormed.has_owner (valid : WellFormed state)
    (live : AllocatedObject state object) :
    ∃ place, OwnerAt state place object :=
  valid.ownership.hasOwner object live

-- OwnerAt includes both owned and showned occurrences in variables, fields,
-- and array elements. This exclusivity is about owners, not unique leases.
theorem WellFormed.unique_owner (valid : WellFormed state)
    (owned : ReferenceAt state place (.owned object)) :
    ∀ other, OwnerAt state other object ↔ other = place := by
  intro other
  constructor
  · intro owner
    rcases owner with unique | shared
    · exact valid.ownership.unique other place object unique owned
    · exact False.elim (valid.ownership.exclusive place other object owned shared)
  · intro same
    subst other
    exact Or.inl owned

theorem initial_rootedOwnership : RootedOwnership (State.initial Primitive) := by
  intro object
  constructor
  · intro allocated
    simp [AllocatedObject, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty] at allocated
  · intro reachable
    exact reachable.allocated (initial_ownershipInvariant Primitive)

theorem initial_wellFormed : WellFormed (State.initial Primitive) := by
  constructor
  · constructor <;> simp [State.initial, LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty]
  · simp [State.initial, LeaseStore.empty, FiniteMap.empty]
  · intro object allocated
    simp [AllocatedObject, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty] at allocated
  · intro place reference stored
    cases place <;> simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
  · intro place object owner
    cases place <;> simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, State.initial, FiniteMap.empty] at owner

private theorem MoveReference.reference_origin
    (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (stored : ReferenceAt after place reference) :
    ∃ oldPlace, ReferenceAt before oldPlace reference := by
  by_cases atDestination : place = destination
  · subst place
    have original : ∃ oldReference, ReferenceAt before source oldReference := by
      cases move with
      | move original _ _ _ _ => exact ⟨_, original⟩
    obtain ⟨oldReference, original⟩ := original
    have same := Slot.initialized.inj (Stored.value_unique (move.reads_back original) stored)
    exact ⟨source, same ▸ original⟩
  · have notSource : place ≠ source := by
      intro same
      subst place
      exact move.source_uninitialized.uninitialized_has_no_reference _ stored
    exact ⟨place, (move.other_references place reference notSource atDestination).mp stored⟩

private theorem MoveReference.transports_owner
    (move : MoveReference before source destination after)
    (owner : OwnerAt before place object) :
    OwnerAt after (if place = source then destination else place) object := by
  rcases owner with unique | shared
  · exact Or.inl (readSlot_stored.mp (by
      simpa only using move.transports_slot (readSlot_stored.mpr unique)))
  · exact Or.inr (readSlot_stored.mp (by
      simpa only using move.transports_slot (readSlot_stored.mpr shared)))

-- A move into a variable can turn an interior ownership edge into a root, but
-- cannot disconnect the moved object or anything below it from all roots.
theorem MoveReference.preserves_owningReachable
    (move : MoveReference before source (.variable destination) after)
    (reachable : OwningReachable before object) : OwningReachable after object := by
  induction reachable with
  | @«variable» rootVariable object owner =>
    have transported := move.transports_owner owner
    by_cases atSource : Place.variable rootVariable = source
    · exact .variable (by simpa only [ite_eq_left atSource] using transported)
    · exact .variable (by simpa only [ite_eq_right atSource] using transported)
  | @field object name target parent owner ih =>
    have transported := move.transports_owner owner
    by_cases atSource : Place.field object name = source
    · exact .variable (by simpa only [ite_eq_left atSource] using transported)
    · exact .field ih (by simpa only [ite_eq_right atSource] using transported)
  | @element object index target parent owner ih =>
    have transported := move.transports_owner owner
    by_cases atSource : Place.element object index = source
    · exact .variable (by simpa only [ite_eq_left atSource] using transported)
    · exact .element ih (by simpa only [ite_eq_right atSource] using transported)

theorem MoveReference.preserves_rootedOwnership
    (move : MoveReference before source (.variable destination) after)
    (ownership : OwnershipInvariant before) (rooted : RootedOwnership before) :
    RootedOwnership after := by
  intro object
  constructor
  · intro allocated
    exact move.preserves_owningReachable
      ((rooted object).mp ((move.liveObjects object).mp allocated))
  · intro reachable
    exact reachable.allocated (move.preserves_ownership ownership)

theorem MoveReference.preserves_wellFormed
    (move : MoveReference before source (.variable destination) after) (valid : WellFormed before) :
    WellFormed after := by
  constructor
  · simpa only [move.preserves_leases] using valid.graph
  · intro id entry object stored root active
    exact (move.liveObjects object).mpr (valid.rootsLive id entry object
      (by simpa only [move.preserves_leases] using stored) root active)
  · intro object allocated
    exact move.preserves_owningReachable
      (valid.allocatedLive object ((move.liveObjects object).mp allocated))
  · intro place reference stored
    obtain ⟨oldPlace, original⟩ := move.reference_origin stored
    obtain ⟨known, live⟩ := valid.slotsValid oldPlace reference original
    constructor
    · simpa only [ReferenceKnown, move.preserves_leases] using known
    · intro usable
      exact (move.liveObjects reference.object).mpr
        (live ((move.referenceUsable reference).mp usable))
  · intro place object unique other owner
    have invariant := move.preserves_ownership valid.ownership
    rcases owner with otherUnique | shared
    · exact invariant.unique other place object otherUnique unique
    · exact False.elim (invariant.exclusive place other object unique shared)

-- Changing only the graph never changes slots, objects, or rooted ownership.
theorem Stored.leaseStore_independent (state : State Primitive) (leases : LeaseStore)
    (place : Place) (slot : Slot) :
    Stored (.state state.objects state.variables leases) place slot ↔ Stored state place slot := by
  cases state
  cases place <;> rfl

theorem OwningReachable.leaseStore_independent (state : State Primitive) (leases : LeaseStore)
    (object : ObjectId) :
    OwningReachable (.state state.objects state.variables leases) object ↔
      OwningReachable state object := by
  have owners : ∀ place target,
      OwnerAt (.state state.objects state.variables leases) place target ↔
        OwnerAt state place target := by
    intro place target
    simp only [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored.leaseStore_independent]
  constructor
  · intro reachable
    induction reachable with
    | «variable» owner => exact .variable ((owners _ _).mp owner)
    | field _ owner ih => exact .field ih ((owners _ _).mp owner)
    | element _ owner ih => exact .element ih ((owners _ _).mp owner)
  · intro reachable
    induction reachable with
    | «variable» owner => exact .variable ((owners _ _).mpr owner)
    | field _ owner ih => exact .field ih ((owners _ _).mpr owner)
    | element _ owner ih => exact .element ih ((owners _ _).mpr owner)

theorem ReferenceAt.storedLease {state : State Primitive} {place : Place}
    {reference : Reference} {id : LeaseId} (stored : ReferenceAt state place reference)
    (loan : reference.lease = some id) : StoredLease state id := by
  cases state with
  | state objects variables leases =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» variableId => exact .variableSlot stored loan
    | field object name =>
      obtain ⟨fields, allocated, member⟩ := stored
      exact .field allocated member loan
    | element object index =>
      obtain ⟨elements, allocated, member⟩ := stored
      exact .element allocated (Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr (Array.mem_of_getElem? member)) loan

private theorem usable_before_invalidation {store : LeaseStore} {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    {id : LeaseId} (usable : LeaseUsable (store.invalidate revoked) id) :
    LeaseUsable store id := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨entry, stored, valid⟩ := usable
  obtain ⟨old, oldStored, rfl⟩ := LeaseStore.invalidate_entry.mp stored
  by_cases revokedId : revoked id
  · simp [revokedId] at valid
  · exact ⟨old, oldStored, by simpa [revokedId] using valid⟩

-- Revocation never breaks well-formedness: invalid borrowers remain known but
-- no longer require a live target. The revocation policy is descendant-closed.
theorem WellFormed.invalidate {state : State Primitive} (wf : WellFormed state)
    {revoked : LeaseId → Prop}
    (closed : ∀ child parent, LeaseParent state.leases child parent →
      revoked parent → revoked child) :
    WellFormed (.state state.objects state.variables (state.leases.invalidate revoked)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · exact LeaseStore.invalidate_wellFormed wf.graph closed
  · intro id entry object stored root valid
    obtain ⟨old, oldStored, rfl⟩ := LeaseStore.invalidate_entry.mp stored
    by_cases revokedId : revoked id
    · simp [revokedId] at valid
    · have oldValid : old.valid = true := by simpa [revokedId] using valid
      exact wf.rootsLive id old object oldStored root oldValid
  · intro object allocated
    exact (OwningReachable.leaseStore_independent _ _ _).mpr
      (wf.allocatedLive object allocated)
  · intro place reference stored
    have original : ReferenceAt state place reference :=
      (Stored.leaseStore_independent _ _ _ _).mp stored
    obtain ⟨known, live⟩ := wf.slotsValid place reference original
    constructor
    · cases loan : reference.lease with
      | none => simp [ReferenceKnown, loan]
      | some id =>
        simp only [ReferenceKnown, loan] at known ⊢
        obtain ⟨entry, stored⟩ := known
        exact ⟨_, LeaseStore.invalidate_stored stored⟩
    · intro usable
      apply live
      cases loan : reference.lease with
      | none => simp [ReferenceUsable, loan]
      | some id =>
        simp only [ReferenceUsable, loan] at usable ⊢
        exact usable_before_invalidation usable
  · intro place object unique other owner
    apply wf.uniqueOwners place object
    · exact (Stored.leaseStore_independent _ _ _ _).mp unique
    · simpa only [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored.leaseStore_independent] using owner

theorem WellFormed.invalidate_owner {state : State Primitive} (wf : WellFormed state)
    (object : ObjectId) :
    WellFormed (.state state.objects state.variables (invalidateOwner state.leases object)) := by
  apply wf.invalidate
  intro child parent edge revoked
  obtain ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, equal | ancestor⟩ := revoked
  · subst parent
    exact ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, Or.inr (.parent edge)⟩
  · exact ⟨root, entry, stored, kind, Or.inr (.trans (.parent edge) ancestor)⟩

theorem WellFormed.invalidate_lease {state : State Primitive} (wf : WellFormed state)
    (authority : LeaseId) :
    WellFormed (.state state.objects state.variables (invalidateLease state.leases authority)) := by
  apply wf.invalidate
  intro child parent edge revoked
  exact .trans (.parent edge) revoked

-- A collected node cannot be retained by any stored handle, valid or invalid.
-- Thus collecting an unreferenced leaf preserves every state's required links.
theorem WellFormed.cleanup {before after : State Primitive} (wf : WellFormed before)
    (step : CleanupLease before after) : WellFormed after := by
  have graph := step.preserves_wellFormed wf.graph
  cases step with
  | remove removed removedEntry found unused =>
    constructor
    · exact graph
    · intro id entry object stored root valid
      exact wf.rootsLive id entry object (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1 root valid
    · intro object allocated
      exact (OwningReachable.leaseStore_independent _ _ _).mpr
        (wf.allocatedLive object allocated)
    · intro place reference stored
      have original : ReferenceAt before place reference :=
        (Stored.leaseStore_independent _ _ _ _).mp stored
      obtain ⟨known, live⟩ := wf.slotsValid place reference original
      constructor
      · cases loan : reference.lease with
        | none => simp [ReferenceKnown, loan]
        | some id =>
          simp only [ReferenceKnown, loan] at known ⊢
          obtain ⟨entry, stored⟩ := known
          have different : id ≠ removed := by
            intro equal
            subst id
            exact unused (Or.inl (original.storedLease loan))
          exact ⟨entry, by simp [FiniteMap.erase, stored, different]⟩
      · intro usable
        apply live
        cases loan : reference.lease with
        | none => simp [ReferenceUsable, loan]
        | some id =>
          simp only [ReferenceUsable, loan] at usable ⊢
          obtain ⟨entry, stored, valid⟩ := usable
          exact ⟨entry, (List.mem_filter.mp stored).1, valid⟩
    · intro place object unique other owner
      apply wf.uniqueOwners place object
      · exact (Stored.leaseStore_independent _ _ _ _).mp unique
      · simpa only [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored.leaseStore_independent] using owner

theorem WellFormed.cleanups {before after : State Primitive} (wf : WellFormed before)
    (steps : CleanupLeases before after) : WellFormed after := by
  induction steps with
  | done => exact wf
  | next step _ ih => exact ih (wf.cleanup step)

private def disconnectedCycle : State Nat :=
  .state ⟨[(⟨0⟩, .aggregate ⟨[("self", .initialized (.owned ⟨0⟩))], by simp⟩)], by simp⟩
    .empty .empty

private theorem disconnectedCycle_ownership : OwnershipInvariant disconnectedCycle := by
  have onlyOwner : ∀ place object, OwnerAt disconnectedCycle place object →
      place = .field ⟨0⟩ "self" ∧ object = ⟨0⟩ := by

      simp [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle, FiniteMap.empty] at owner
    | field id name =>
      rcases owner with owner | owner
      all_goals
        simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle] at owner
        obtain ⟨fields, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, field⟩ := owner
        simp_all [Reference.owned, Reference.showned]
    | element id index =>
      simp [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle] at owner
  constructor
  · intro place object owner
    obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := onlyOwner _ _ owner
    simp [AllocatedObject, disconnectedCycle]
  · intro object allocated
    simp [AllocatedObject, disconnectedCycle] at allocated
    subst object
    exact ⟨.field ⟨0⟩ "self", Or.inl (by simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle])⟩
  · intro place other object first second
    exact (onlyOwner _ _ (Or.inl first)).1.trans (onlyOwner _ _ (Or.inl second)).1.symm
  · intro place other object _ shared
    cases other with
    | «variable» id =>
      simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle, FiniteMap.empty] at shared
    | field id name =>
      simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle] at shared
      obtain ⟨fields, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, field⟩ := shared
      simp [Reference.owned, Reference.showned] at field
    | element id index => simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle] at shared

private theorem disconnectedCycle_not_rooted : ¬ RootedOwnership disconnectedCycle := by
  have noRoot : ∀ object, ¬ OwningReachable disconnectedCycle object := by
    intro object reachable
    induction reachable with
    | «variable» owner =>
      simp [OwnerAt, ReferenceAt, Stored, disconnectedCycle, FiniteMap.empty] at owner
    | field _ _ ih => exact ih
    | element _ _ ih => exact ih
  intro rooted
  exact noRoot ⟨0⟩ ((rooted ⟨0⟩).mp (by simp [AllocatedObject, disconnectedCycle]))

-- A field owning its own containing object supplies a local owner and a valid
-- reference, but there is no path from a variable that keeps the object live.
-- ANCHOR: disconnected_owning_cycle_not_wellFormed
example :
    OwnershipInvariant disconnectedCycle ∧
    ¬ RootedOwnership disconnectedCycle ∧ ¬ WellFormed disconnectedCycle := by

  intro valid

-- ANCHOR_END: disconnected_owning_cycle_not_wellFormed

-- The target has been destroyed, but the invalid lease and its stored handle
-- remain. Such a state is well formed; trying to use the handle is UB.
private def invalidBorrowState : State Nat :=
  .state .empty ⟨[(⟨0⟩, .initialized (.borrow .shared ⟨0⟩ ⟨0⟩))], by simp⟩

-- ANCHOR: invalid_borrow_remains_wellFormed
example : WellFormed invalidBorrowState ∧

  · constructor
    · constructor

        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := stored
        decide
      · intro id entry stored parent member
        simp [invalidBorrowState] at stored
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := stored

      · intro id entry parents stored kind
        simp [invalidBorrowState] at stored
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := stored

      · intro id entry stored active
        simp [invalidBorrowState] at stored
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := stored

        · simp [ReferenceUsable, Reference.borrow, LeaseUsable, invalidBorrowState]

        simp [ReferenceAt, Stored, invalidBorrowState, FiniteMap.empty] at stored
